overview.en: The bones around the jaw joint, the temporomandibular joint with its disc and ligaments, and fourteen muscles in three groups (mastication, suprahyoid, facial expression), each with origin, insertion, course, action and nerve.
overview.zh: 颞下颌关节周围的骨、带关节盘和韧带的颞下颌关节，以及分三组的 14 块肌肉（咀嚼肌、舌骨上肌、表情肌），每块写明起点、止点、走行、动作和神经。

text.en: The jaw joint is formed by two bones: the mandible below and the temporal bone above. Three neighbours complete the region. The zygomatic bone joins the temporal bone to make the zygomatic arch, the sphenoid bone carries the pterygoid plates and the foramen ovale, and the maxilla holds the upper teeth. The hyoid bone hangs below the mandible and anchors the muscles that open the mouth.
text.zh: 颞下颌关节由两块骨构成：下方的下颌骨和上方的颞骨。另有三块相邻的骨：颧骨与颞骨连成颧弓，蝶骨带有翼突骨板和卵圆孔，上颌骨承托上牙。舌骨悬在下颌骨下方，是张口肌的附着处。

text.en: The mandible has a horseshoe-shaped body that holds the 16 lower teeth and, on each side, a vertical ramus. The ramus ends above in two processes separated by the mandibular notch: the coronoid process in front, for temporalis, and the condylar process behind, whose head forms the joint. The body meets the ramus at the angle of the mandible.
text.zh: 下颌骨有一个容纳 16 颗下牙的马蹄形下颌体，两侧各有一块垂直的下颌支。下颌支上端分为两个突起，中间隔着下颌切迹：前方是冠突，供颞肌附着；后方是髁突，它的头参与构成关节。下颌体与下颌支相交处是下颌角。

text.en: Two openings mark the path of the nerve to the lower teeth. The inferior alveolar nerve enters the mandibular foramen on the inner side of the ramus, runs forward in the mandibular canal, and ends as the mental nerve, which leaves through the mental foramen on the outer side of the body. The inner surface of the body also carries the mylohyoid line, the digastric fossa and the mental spines, each named for the muscle attached there.
text.zh: 下颌骨上有两个孔标出下牙神经的路径。下牙槽神经从下颌支内侧的下颌孔进入，在下颌管内向前走行，末端成为颏神经，从下颌体外侧的颏孔穿出。下颌体内面还有下颌舌骨线、二腹肌窝和颏棘，各以附着其上的肌命名。

text.en: The temporal bone has a flat squamous part, a tympanic part around the external acoustic meatus, a petromastoid part that holds the inner ear and ends below in the mastoid process, and two processes: the zygomatic process, which runs forward to the zygomatic arch, and the slender styloid process. On its underside lie the mandibular fossa and, in front of it, the articular tubercle; these two surfaces receive the head of the mandible.
text.zh: 颞骨有扁平的鳞部、围绕外耳道的鼓部、容纳内耳并向下形成乳突的岩乳部，以及两个突起：向前参与构成颧弓的颧突和细长的茎突。颞骨下面有下颌窝，其前方是关节结节；这两个面与下颌头相关节。

text.en: The sphenoid bone contributes the greater wing, which roofs the infratemporal fossa, and the pterygoid process with its medial and lateral plates. The mandibular nerve leaves the skull through the foramen ovale in the greater wing, and the lateral pterygoid plate gives origin to both pterygoid muscles.
text.zh: 蝶骨提供构成颞下窝顶的蝶骨大翼，以及带内侧板、外侧板的翼突。下颌神经经大翼上的卵圆孔出颅，翼突外侧板是两块翼肌的起点。

text.en: Two fossae on the side of the skull hold the muscles of mastication. The temporal fossa lies above the zygomatic arch and is filled by temporalis. The infratemporal fossa lies below it, deep to the ramus of the mandible, and holds the two pterygoid muscles, the maxillary artery, the pterygoid venous plexus and the branches of the mandibular nerve. The two fossae communicate through the gap deep to the zygomatic arch.
text.zh: 颅侧面有两个窝容纳咀嚼肌。颞窝在颧弓上方，被颞肌填满。颞下窝在其下方、下颌支深面，内有两块翼肌、上颌动脉、翼静脉丛和下颌神经的分支。两个窝经颧弓深面的间隙相通。

text.en: The hyoid bone is a U-shaped bone in the front of the neck with a body, two greater horns and two lesser horns. It articulates with no other bone and is held in place only by muscles and ligaments. The four suprahyoid muscles attach to it from above, and the infrahyoid muscles (sternohyoid, omohyoid and thyrohyoid) attach from below.
text.zh: 舌骨是颈前部的 U 形骨，有一个体、两个大角和两个小角。它不与任何骨相关节，只靠肌和韧带悬吊。四块舌骨上肌从上方附着于它，舌骨下肌（胸骨舌骨肌、肩胛舌骨肌和甲状舌骨肌）从下方附着。

text.en: The temporomandibular joint (TMJ) is a synovial joint between the head of the mandible and the mandibular fossa and articular tubercle of the temporal bone. It both hinges and glides, so it is called a ginglymoarthrodial joint. The right and left joints are tied together by the single mandible: neither can move without the other.
text.zh: 颞下颌关节（TMJ）是下颌头与颞骨下颌窝、关节结节之间的滑膜关节。它既能做铰链运动又能滑动，因此称为屈戌滑动关节（ginglymoarthrodial joint）。左右两个关节由同一块下颌骨相连，一侧动另一侧必然跟着动。

text.en: Two features set it apart from most synovial joints. Its bony surfaces are covered by fibrocartilage, not hyaline cartilage, and an articular disc lies between them. The fibrocartilage can change its water content as load changes during chewing.
text.zh: 它有两点不同于多数滑膜关节：骨性关节面覆盖的是纤维软骨而不是透明软骨；两个关节面之间隔着一块关节盘。咀嚼时负荷变化，纤维软骨能随之调节含水量。

text.en: The articular disc is an oval, biconcave plate of dense fibrous tissue (most descriptions call it fibrocartilage). It has a thick anterior band of about 2 mm, a thick posterior band of about 3 mm and a thinner intermediate zone between them. The disc itself has no blood vessels and very little nerve supply.
text.zh: 关节盘是一块椭圆形、双凹的致密纤维组织板（多数资料称为纤维软骨）。它有约 2 mm 厚的前带、约 3 mm 厚的后带，以及两者之间较薄的中间带。关节盘本身没有血管，神经也很少。

text.en: The disc divides the joint into two compartments, each lined by its own synovial membrane. In the lower compartment, between the disc and the condyle, the condyle rotates like a hinge. In the upper compartment, between the disc and the temporal bone, the disc and condyle glide forward and backward together.
text.zh: 关节盘把关节腔分成上下两个腔，各有自己的滑膜。在关节盘与髁突之间的下腔，髁突像铰链一样转动。在关节盘与颞骨之间的上腔，关节盘带着髁突一起前后滑动。

text.en: The disc is anchored on all sides. Collateral ligaments tie its medial and lateral edges to the poles of the condyle, so the disc travels with the condyle. In front it blends with the capsule and receives some fibres of the superior head of the lateral pterygoid. Behind, the posterior band continues into the retrodiscal tissue (bilaminar zone), a loose pad that is rich in blood vessels and nerves and is a common source of joint pain.
text.zh: 关节盘四周都有固定。侧副韧带把它的内外缘系在髁突的内外极上，所以关节盘跟随髁突移动。前方它与关节囊融合，并接受翼外肌上头的部分纤维。后方，后带延续为盘后组织（双板区），这是一团富含血管和神经的疏松组织，是关节疼痛的常见来源。

text.en: The capsule is a fibrous sleeve from the margins of the mandibular fossa and articular tubercle down to the neck of the mandible. It is thin and loose in front and behind and thick on the lateral side, where it forms the lateral ligament. Two more ligaments lie at a distance from the joint and act as check ligaments.
text.zh: 关节囊是一个纤维套，上起下颌窝和关节结节的边缘，下止于下颌颈。它的前后部薄而松，外侧部增厚形成外侧韧带。另有两条韧带离关节稍远，起限制作用。

rows.en: From the articular tubercle at the root of the zygomatic arch to the lateral and posterior border of the neck of the mandible; a thickening of the capsule
rows.zh: 自颧弓根部的关节结节至下颌颈的外侧缘和后缘；是关节囊的增厚部

rows.en: Backward movement of the condyle; it strengthens the joint laterally and helps prevent posterior dislocation
rows.zh: 髁突向后移动；从外侧加强关节，防止后脱位

rows.en: From the spine of the sphenoid to the lingula beside the mandibular foramen; a remnant of Meckel's cartilage
rows.zh: 自蝶骨棘至下颌孔旁的下颌小舌；是 Meckel 软骨的残余

rows.en: Excessive forward translation of the condyle once the mouth has opened more than about 10 degrees
rows.zh: 张口超过约 10 度后髁突过度向前滑动

rows.en: From the styloid process to the posterior margin and angle of the mandible; a thickening of the parotid fascia
rows.zh: 自茎突至下颌骨后缘和下颌角；是腮腺筋膜的增厚部

text.en: The joint is supplied by two branches of the mandibular nerve: the auriculotemporal nerve to the posterior and lateral capsule and the masseteric nerve to the anterior capsule. Its main artery is the superficial temporal artery, helped by branches of the maxillary artery; blood drains to the pterygoid venous plexus behind the disc.
text.zh: 关节由下颌神经的两条分支支配：耳颞神经管关节囊的后部和外侧部，咬肌神经管前部。主要动脉是颞浅动脉，上颌动脉的分支也参与；静脉血汇入关节盘后方的翼静脉丛。

text.en: Four muscles on each side move the mandible in chewing: masseter, temporalis, medial pterygoid and lateral pterygoid. All four develop from the first pharyngeal arch, so all four are supplied by the mandibular nerve (CN V3), and all receive blood from branches of the maxillary artery. Three of them close the jaw; only the lateral pterygoid opens it.
text.zh: 每侧有四块肌在咀嚼时带动下颌骨：咬肌、颞肌、翼内肌和翼外肌。四块肌都发育自第一咽弓，所以都由下颌神经（CN V3）支配，血液都来自上颌动脉的分支。其中三块闭口，只有翼外肌张口。

text.en: Masseter and temporalis lie on the outside and can be felt through the skin. Masseter is a thick rectangle from the zygomatic arch to the outer side of the ramus and angle; it bulges in front of the angle when the teeth are clenched. Temporalis is a fan that fills the temporal fossa; its tendon passes deep to the zygomatic arch to the coronoid process. Its front fibres run vertically and its back fibres almost horizontally, which is why the same muscle both lifts and retracts the mandible.
text.zh: 咬肌和颞肌位于外侧，隔着皮肤可以摸到。咬肌是厚而呈长方形的肌，自颧弓至下颌支和下颌角的外侧；咬紧牙时在下颌角前方隆起。颞肌呈扇形填满颞窝，肌腱从颧弓深面下行到冠突。它的前部纤维垂直、后部纤维近水平，所以同一块肌既能上提又能后缩下颌骨。

text.en: The two pterygoid muscles lie in the infratemporal fossa, hidden by the ramus. Medial pterygoid mirrors masseter on the inner side of the ramus, so the angle of the mandible lies between the two muscles. Lateral pterygoid is the only muscle of mastication with horizontal fibres: it runs straight back from the sphenoid to the neck of the mandible and the joint, so it pulls the condyle and disc forward.
text.zh: 两块翼肌位于颞下窝，被下颌支挡住。翼内肌在下颌支内侧与咬肌相对，下颌角就夹在这两块肌之间。翼外肌是咀嚼肌中唯一纤维呈水平方向的肌：它从蝶骨一直向后走到下颌颈和关节，所以能把髁突和关节盘拉向前方。

text.en: How many layers the masseter has depends on the description: most give two parts, superficial and deep, while some add an intermediate layer. How much of the lateral pterygoid reaches the disc is also unsettled; the usual statement is that only some fibres of the superior head do.
text.zh: 咬肌分几层因资料而异：多数分为浅、深两部，有的再加一个中间层。翼外肌有多少纤维止于关节盘也没有定论；通常的说法是只有上头的部分纤维到达关节盘。

text.en: Four muscles connect the hyoid bone to the mandible and the skull base: digastric, mylohyoid, geniohyoid and stylohyoid. In swallowing they lift the hyoid bone and the floor of the mouth. When the infrahyoid muscles hold the hyoid bone still, the same muscles pull the mandible down, which makes them the main helpers of the lateral pterygoid in opening the mouth.
text.zh: 四块肌把舌骨连到下颌骨和颅底：二腹肌、下颌舌骨肌、颏舌骨肌和茎突舌骨肌。吞咽时它们上提舌骨和口底。当舌骨下肌把舌骨固定住时，这几块肌反过来把下颌骨拉向下方，因此是翼外肌张口时的主要帮手。

text.en: Their nerves follow their embryology, not their position. Mylohyoid and the anterior belly of the digastric come from the first pharyngeal arch and receive the nerve to mylohyoid (CN V3). Stylohyoid and the posterior belly of the digastric come from the second arch and receive the facial nerve (CN VII). Geniohyoid receives C1 fibres that travel with the hypoglossal nerve.
text.zh: 它们的神经支配取决于胚胎来源，而不是位置。下颌舌骨肌和二腹肌前腹来自第一咽弓，由下颌舌骨肌神经（CN V3）支配。茎突舌骨肌和二腹肌后腹来自第二咽弓，由面神经（CN VII）支配。颏舌骨肌由随舌下神经走行的 C1 纤维支配。

text.en: The muscles of facial expression arise from bone or fascia and insert into the skin, so they move the skin and the openings of the face, not joints. They all develop from the second pharyngeal arch and are all supplied by the facial nerve (CN VII). Six are covered here because they are the ones tested at the bedside: occipitofrontalis, orbicularis oculi, zygomaticus major, orbicularis oris, buccinator and platysma.
text.zh: 表情肌起自骨或筋膜，止于皮肤，所以它们牵动的是皮肤和面部的孔裂，而不是关节。它们都发育自第二咽弓，都由面神经（CN VII）支配。这里讲六块，因为床旁检查查的就是它们：枕额肌、眼轮匝肌、颧大肌、口轮匝肌、颊肌和颈阔肌。

text.en: Several of them meet at the modiolus, a dense, mobile knot of muscle fibres just lateral to each angle of the mouth. Buccinator, orbicularis oris and zygomaticus major all attach there, which is why the corner of the mouth drops as a whole when the facial nerve fails.
text.zh: 其中几块在蜗轴处交汇。蜗轴是口角外侧一个致密而可活动的肌纤维结。颊肌、口轮匝肌和颧大肌都附着于此，所以面神经麻痹时口角整体下垂。

text.en: Buccinator is often grouped with the muscles of mastication because it keeps food between the teeth, but its motor nerve is the facial nerve. The buccal nerve of CN V3 passes over it and carries only sensation from the cheek.
text.zh: 颊肌因为能把食物留在上下牙之间，常被和咀嚼肌放在一起，但它的运动神经是面神经。CN V3 的颊神经经过颊肌表面，只传导颊部的感觉。

overview.en: Two cranial nerves run this region. The trigeminal nerve (CN V) carries sensation from the face and drives the muscles of mastication; the facial nerve (CN VII) drives the muscles of facial expression. The section follows each from the brainstem to its end branches.
overview.zh: 这个区域由两条脑神经管理。三叉神经（CN V）传导面部感觉并支配咀嚼肌；面神经（CN VII）支配表情肌。本部分把两条神经从脑干一直讲到末梢分支。

heading.en: CN = cranial nerve; V1, V2, V3 = divisions of the trigeminal nerve; C = cervical
heading.zh: CN = 脑神经；V1、V2、V3 = 三叉神经的三个分支；C = 颈部

paragraphs.en: Most muscles in earlier chapters were supplied by spinal nerves, written with C, T, L or S. The head is different: its muscles are supplied by cranial nerves, written CN with a Roman numeral. CN V is the trigeminal nerve and CN VII is the facial nerve. V1, V2 and V3 are the three divisions of CN V; they are parts of one cranial nerve, not spinal levels.
paragraphs.zh: 前面各章的肌肉大多由脊神经支配，用 C、T、L、S 表示。头部不同：这里的肌肉由脑神经支配，写作 CN 加罗马数字。CN V 是三叉神经，CN VII 是面神经。V1、V2、V3 是 CN V 的三个分支，属于同一条脑神经，不是脊髓节段。

paragraphs.en: Only two spinal levels appear in this chapter, both cervical (C). Geniohyoid is supplied by C1 fibres that travel with the hypoglossal nerve (CN XII), and the skin over the angle of the mandible is supplied by cervical nerves C2–C3, not by the trigeminal nerve. No thoracic (T), lumbar (L) or sacral (S) level is involved.
paragraphs.zh: 本章只出现两处脊髓节段，都是颈部（C）。颏舌骨肌由随舌下神经（CN XII）走行的 C1 纤维支配；下颌角表面的皮肤由颈神经 C2–C3 支配，而不是三叉神经。本章不涉及胸部（T）、腰部（L）或骶部（S）节段。

text.en: The trigeminal nerve is the largest cranial nerve. It is mixed: a large sensory root carries touch, pain and temperature from the face, mouth and teeth, and a small motor root supplies the muscles of mastication. Both roots attach to the side of the pons. Four nuclei serve it: the mesencephalic, principal sensory and spinal nuclei for sensation, and one motor nucleus.
text.zh: 三叉神经是最粗大的脑神经。它是混合神经：粗大的感觉根传导面部、口腔和牙齿的触觉、痛觉和温度觉，细小的运动根支配咀嚼肌。两个根都连于脑桥侧面。它有四个核：管感觉的中脑核、感觉主核和脊束核，以及一个运动核。

text.en: The sensory root swells into the trigeminal ganglion, which lies in a pocket of dura called the trigeminal cave in the middle cranial fossa. Three divisions leave the ganglion: the ophthalmic nerve (V1) through the superior orbital fissure, the maxillary nerve (V2) through the foramen rotundum and the mandibular nerve (V3) through the foramen ovale. The motor root passes under the ganglion and joins only V3, so V1 and V2 are purely sensory and V3 is mixed.
text.zh: 感觉根膨大形成三叉神经节，位于颅中窝一个称为三叉神经腔的硬脑膜囊内。神经节发出三个分支：眼神经（V1）经眶上裂出颅，上颌神经（V2）经圆孔出颅，下颌神经（V3）经卵圆孔出颅。运动根从神经节下方经过，只加入 V3，所以 V1 和 V2 是纯感觉神经，V3 是混合神经。

rows.en: Forehead and scalp up to the vertex, upper eyelid, cornea, bridge and tip of the nose
rows.zh: 前额和头皮直到头顶、上睑、角膜、鼻背和鼻尖

rows.en: Lower eyelid, side of the nose, cheek, upper lip; upper teeth
rows.zh: 下睑、鼻侧、面颊、上唇；上牙

rows.en: Lower lip, chin, lower third of the face, the area in front of the ear and the temple; lower teeth
rows.zh: 下唇、颏部、面部下三分之一、耳前区和颞部；下牙

rows.en: Muscles of mastication, mylohyoid, anterior belly of digastric, tensor tympani, tensor veli palatini
rows.zh: 咀嚼肌、下颌舌骨肌、二腹肌前腹、鼓膜张肌、腭帆张肌

text.en: Two bedside tests use these pathways. In the corneal reflex, touching the cornea sends a signal along V1 and both eyes blink through the facial nerve, so the reflex checks CN V and CN VII together. The jaw jerk, a tap on the relaxed chin, tests the mesencephalic nucleus and the motor root; a slight or absent response is normal.
text.zh: 有两个床旁检查用到这些通路。角膜反射：触碰角膜，信号经 V1 传入，再经面神经使双眼眨动，所以它同时检查 CN V 和 CN VII。下颌反射：轻叩放松的颏部，检查中脑核和运动根；反应轻微或引不出都属正常。

text.en: The mandibular nerve drops through the foramen ovale into the infratemporal fossa, where it lies deep to the lateral pterygoid. Its short trunk gives a meningeal branch and the nerve to medial pterygoid, then splits into a small anterior division, which is mostly motor, and a large posterior division, which is mostly sensory.
text.zh: 下颌神经经卵圆孔下行进入颞下窝，位于翼外肌深面。它的主干很短，发出脑膜支和翼内肌神经后，分成较细、以运动为主的前干和较粗、以感觉为主的后干。

items.en: Meningeal branch: re-enters the skull through the foramen spinosum to supply the dura of the middle cranial fossa.
items.zh: 脑膜支：经棘孔返回颅内，支配颅中窝的硬脑膜。

items.en: Nerve to medial pterygoid: supplies medial pterygoid and also tensor veli palatini and tensor tympani.
items.zh: 翼内肌神经：支配翼内肌，也支配腭帆张肌和鼓膜张肌。

paragraphs.en: Three motor branches and one sensory branch.
paragraphs.zh: 三条运动支和一条感觉支。

items.en: Masseteric nerve: passes above the lateral pterygoid and through the mandibular notch to the deep surface of masseter; gives a branch to the front of the joint.
items.zh: 咬肌神经：从翼外肌上方经过，穿下颌切迹到咬肌深面；发出一支到关节前部。

items.en: Deep temporal nerves: an anterior and a posterior nerve climb to the deep surface of temporalis.
items.zh: 颞深神经：前、后两条，上行至颞肌深面。

items.en: Nerve to lateral pterygoid: supplies both heads.
items.zh: 翼外肌神经：支配上、下两头。

items.en: Buccal nerve: sensory; passes between the two heads of the lateral pterygoid to the skin of the cheek and the mucosa and gum inside it. It does not supply buccinator.
items.zh: 颊神经：感觉神经；从翼外肌两头之间穿出，分布于面颊皮肤及其内面的黏膜和牙龈。它不支配颊肌。

paragraphs.en: Three large branches; only one small motor nerve.
paragraphs.zh: 三条大分支；只有一条细小的运动神经。

items.en: Auriculotemporal nerve: its two roots encircle the middle meningeal artery; it passes behind the neck of the mandible and the joint and climbs in front of the ear. It supplies the back of the joint capsule, the tragus, the external acoustic meatus, the outer surface of the eardrum and the skin of the temple, and carries secretory fibres to the parotid gland.
items.zh: 耳颞神经：两个根环绕脑膜中动脉；经下颌颈和关节的后方，在耳前上行。它支配关节囊后部、耳屏、外耳道、鼓膜外面和颞部皮肤，并带有到腮腺的分泌纤维。

items.en: Lingual nerve: runs deep to the lateral pterygoid, where the chorda tympani joins it; it carries general sensation from the anterior two-thirds of the tongue, the floor of the mouth and the inner gum.
items.zh: 舌神经：走在翼外肌深面，鼓索在此加入；传导舌前三分之二、口底和舌侧牙龈的一般感觉。

items.en: Inferior alveolar nerve: runs between the ramus and the sphenomandibular ligament, gives off the nerve to mylohyoid, then enters the mandibular foramen and supplies the lower teeth. It ends as the mental nerve, which leaves the mental foramen for the chin and lower lip.
items.zh: 下牙槽神经：走在下颌支与蝶下颌韧带之间，先发出下颌舌骨肌神经，再进入下颌孔，支配下牙。末端成为颏神经，出颏孔分布于颏部和下唇。

items.en: Nerve to mylohyoid: supplies mylohyoid and the anterior belly of digastric.
items.zh: 下颌舌骨肌神经：支配下颌舌骨肌和二腹肌前腹。

text.en: Two of these branches carry borrowed fibres. Taste from the anterior two-thirds of the tongue and the secretory fibres for the submandibular and sublingual glands belong to the chorda tympani, a branch of the facial nerve that only travels with the lingual nerve. The secretory fibres for the parotid gland come from the glossopharyngeal nerve (CN IX), relay in the otic ganglion just below the foramen ovale and travel with the auriculotemporal nerve.
text.zh: 其中两条分支带有“借道”的纤维。舌前三分之二的味觉和到下颌下腺、舌下腺的分泌纤维属于鼓索，它是面神经的分支，只是随舌神经走行。到腮腺的分泌纤维来自舌咽神经（CN IX），在卵圆孔下方的耳神经节换元后随耳颞神经走行。

text.en: For the jaw joint the two nerves to remember are the auriculotemporal nerve behind and the masseteric nerve in front. For dentistry it is the inferior alveolar nerve: an anaesthetic block beside the mandibular foramen numbs the lower teeth, and a needle placed too far medially can injure the medial pterygoid and leave the patient unable to open the mouth fully.
text.zh: 对颞下颌关节来说，要记住的两条神经是后方的耳颞神经和前方的咬肌神经。对口腔科来说则是下牙槽神经：在下颌孔旁做阻滞麻醉可使下牙麻木；针尖过于偏内会伤到翼内肌，造成张口受限。

text.en: The facial nerve arises from the pons as a large motor root and a small sensory root, the nervus intermedius, which carries taste and parasympathetic fibres. Both enter the internal acoustic meatus and run through the facial canal inside the temporal bone, bending at the geniculate ganglion. The nerve leaves the skull through the stylomastoid foramen, just behind the styloid process.
text.zh: 面神经自脑桥发出，有一个粗大的运动根和一个细小的感觉根（中间神经，含味觉纤维和副交感纤维）。两根进入内耳道，在颞骨内的面神经管中走行，在膝神经节处转弯。面神经经茎乳孔出颅，茎乳孔就在茎突的后方。

rows.en: Secretory fibres to the lacrimal gland and to the glands of the nose and palate
rows.zh: 到泪腺以及鼻、腭腺体的分泌纤维
普通声音显得过响（听觉过敏）

rows.en: Taste from the anterior two-thirds of the tongue; secretory fibres to the submandibular and sublingual glands
rows.zh: 舌前三分之二的味觉；到下颌下腺和舌下腺的分泌纤维

text.en: Outside the skull the nerve first gives the posterior auricular nerve, to the occipital belly of occipitofrontalis, and branches to the posterior belly of digastric and to stylohyoid. It then enters the parotid gland, which it crosses but does not supply, and divides into an upper and a lower trunk. Within the gland the nerve is the most superficial structure; the retromandibular vein and the external carotid artery lie deeper.
text.zh: 出颅后，面神经先发出耳后神经（到枕额肌枕腹），以及到二腹肌后腹和茎突舌骨肌的分支。然后进入腮腺；它只是穿过腮腺而不支配腮腺，并分为上、下两干。在腮腺内，面神经位置最浅，下颌后静脉和颈外动脉在更深处。

rows.en: Frontal belly of occipitofrontalis, upper orbicularis oculi
rows.zh: 枕额肌额腹、眼轮匝肌上部

rows.en: Muscles of the lower lip and chin
Tense the skin of the neck

text.en: The buccal branches of the facial nerve are motor and must not be confused with the buccal nerve of V3, which is sensory. Both reach the cheek: the facial nerve moves buccinator, while the buccal nerve of V3 feels the skin and mucosa over it.
text.zh: 面神经的颊支是运动神经，不要与 V3 的颊神经（感觉神经）混淆。两者都到面颊：面神经让颊肌收缩，V3 的颊神经管颊肌表面皮肤和黏膜的感觉。
2.4 每块肌由哪条神经支配

text.en: The rule follows the embryo. Muscles from the first pharyngeal arch are supplied by the mandibular nerve, and muscles from the second arch by the facial nerve. Digastric crosses the boundary, so its two bellies have different nerves. Geniohyoid belongs to neither arch and is supplied by C1.
text.zh: 规律来自胚胎发育。第一咽弓来源的肌由下颌神经支配，第二咽弓来源的肌由面神经支配。二腹肌跨在两弓之间，所以前后两腹神经不同。颏舌骨肌不属于这两个咽弓，由 C1 支配。

rows.zh: 下颌舌骨肌；二腹肌前腹
二腹肌后腹；茎突舌骨肌
二腹肌支和茎突舌骨肌支

rows.en: C1 fibres travelling with the hypoglossal nerve
rows.zh: 随舌下神经走行的 C1 纤维

rows.en: Temporal branches (frontal belly); posterior auricular nerve (occipital belly)
rows.zh: 颞支（额腹）；耳后神经（枕腹）

rows.en: Buccal branches (zygomatic branches also reach zygomaticus major; the marginal mandibular branch may reach orbicularis oris)
rows.zh: 颊支（颧支也到颧大肌；下颌缘支可到口轮匝肌）

overview.en: How the jaw opens, closes, slides forward and grinds sideways: which compartment of the joint moves, which muscles drive each movement, and what normal range looks like when it is measured.
overview.zh: 下颌怎样张开、闭合、前伸和侧方研磨：关节的哪个腔在动、每个动作由哪些肌带动，以及测量时正常范围是多少。

text.en: The mandible makes five movements at the temporomandibular joints: depression (opening), elevation (closing), protrusion (sliding forward), retrusion (sliding backward) and lateral excursion (moving to one side). Chewing combines all of them. The two joints always work as a pair, and the movement ends at a hard stop that no other joint has: the teeth meeting.
text.zh: 下颌骨在颞下颌关节处有五种运动：下降（张口）、上提（闭口）、前伸、后缩和侧方运动。咀嚼是这些动作的组合。两侧关节总是成对工作，而且运动终点是其他关节没有的硬性止点：上下牙相碰。

rows.en: Both rotate, then both glide forward with the discs
rows.zh: 两侧先转动，再带着关节盘向前滑动

rows.en: Gravity for a relaxed opening; lateral pterygoid (inferior head), digastric, geniohyoid and mylohyoid against resistance or for a wide opening
rows.zh: 放松张口靠重力；抗阻或大张口时为翼外肌（下头）、二腹肌、颏舌骨肌和下颌舌骨肌

rows.en: Both glide back and rotate closed
Lateral pterygoid of both sides, helped by medial pterygoid and the superficial fibres of masseter
rows.zh: 两侧翼外肌，翼内肌和咬肌浅部纤维协助

rows.en: Posterior fibres of temporalis, helped by the deep fibres of masseter and by digastric
rows.zh: 颞肌后部纤维，咬肌深部纤维和二腹肌协助

rows.en: The condyle on the side the chin moves toward spins in place; the opposite condyle glides forward and medially
rows.zh: 颏部移向的那一侧髁突原地旋转；对侧髁突向前内侧滑动

rows.en: Lateral and medial pterygoid of the opposite side; temporalis and masseter of the same side hold the pivot
rows.zh: 对侧的翼外肌和翼内肌；同侧颞肌和咬肌稳住转动轴

text.en: Opening happens in two stages, one in each compartment of the joint. The order matters clinically, because a disc that blocks the second stage leaves the patient with only the first.
text.zh: 张口分两个阶段，分别发生在关节的两个腔。这个顺序在临床上很重要：如果关节盘挡住了第二阶段，患者就只剩第一阶段的张口度。

paragraphs.en: The condyle sits centred in the mandibular fossa with the disc on top of it, the thick posterior band over the crest of the condyle.
paragraphs.zh: 髁突位于下颌窝中央，关节盘盖在上面，较厚的后带位于髁突顶上。

paragraphs.en: The condyle rotates like a hinge under the disc, in the lower compartment. This gives roughly the first 20 mm of opening between the incisors.
paragraphs.zh: 髁突在关节盘下方像铰链一样转动，发生在下腔。这一阶段大约提供切牙间最初的 20 mm 张口度。

paragraphs.en: The condyle and disc glide forward together along the slope of the articular tubercle, in the upper compartment, while rotation continues. At full opening the condyle lies under the tubercle.
paragraphs.zh: 髁突和关节盘一起沿关节结节的斜面向前滑动，发生在上腔，同时转动仍在继续。完全张口时髁突位于关节结节下方。

text.en: During translation the lateral pterygoid pulls the condyle and disc forward, and the retrodiscal tissue behind them stretches. What the superior head of the lateral pterygoid does at this moment is disputed: one view has it guiding the disc forward, another has it relaxing during opening and working during closing to steady the disc as it returns.
text.zh: 滑动阶段翼外肌把髁突和关节盘拉向前方，它们后方的盘后组织被拉长。翼外肌上头此时的作用有争议：一种看法是它引导关节盘向前，另一种看法是它在张口时放松、在闭口时收缩，稳住回位的关节盘。

text.en: The direction of each muscle explains its action. Masseter and medial pterygoid pull upward on the two sides of the ramus. The anterior fibres of temporalis pull the coronoid process straight up, and its posterior fibres pull it backward. The lateral pterygoid pulls the neck of the mandible forward, and the suprahyoid muscles pull the chin down and back when the hyoid bone is held steady by the infrahyoid muscles.
text.zh: 每块肌的方向决定它的作用。咬肌和翼内肌分别在下颌支的内外两侧向上拉。颞肌前部纤维把冠突垂直向上提，后部纤维把它向后拉。翼外肌把下颌颈向前拉；当舌骨被舌骨下肌固定时，舌骨上肌把颏部向后下方拉。

text.en: Chewing on one side uses these pulls in turn. The jaw opens, swings toward the side of the food as the opposite pterygoids contract, and then closes with masseter, temporalis and medial pterygoid crushing the food between the molars. Buccinator and the tongue keep the food on the teeth.
text.zh: 单侧咀嚼依次用到这些拉力。下颌先张开，对侧两块翼肌收缩使它摆向食物一侧，然后咬肌、颞肌和翼内肌闭口，把食物在磨牙间压碎。颊肌和舌把食物保持在牙面上。

text.en: 3.4 Normal range and how to measure it

Mouth opening is measured with a ruler between the edges of the upper and lower central incisors. Normal opening is about 40 to 50 mm, and about 35 to 40 mm is enough for daily function. A quick screen is whether the patient can fit three of their own fingers, stacked vertically, between the incisors. Sideways movement is measured between the midlines of the upper and lower teeth.
text.zh: 张口度用尺子在上下中切牙切缘之间测量。正常张口度约 40～50 mm，日常功能约需 35～40 mm。快速筛查的方法是看患者能否把自己的三根手指竖着叠放进上下切牙之间。侧方运动在上下牙中线之间测量。

text.en: The path matters as much as the distance. Watch the chin from the front as the mouth opens: it should travel straight down. A path that swings to one side and stays there, or that curves away and comes back like a letter C or S, points to a joint or muscle that is not moving evenly on the two sides. Record the path together with the range.
text.zh: 张口的轨迹与距离同样重要。从正面看张口时的颏部：它应当直线向下。如果轨迹偏向一侧不回来，或者像字母 C 或 S 那样偏出去又回来，说明两侧关节或肌肉的运动不对称。记录张口度时要同时记录轨迹。

rows.en: Lips together, teeth slightly apart (about 2 mm)
rows.zh: 双唇闭合，上下牙略分开（约 2 mm）

text.en: The jaw does not move alone. Opening the mouth is accompanied by a small extension of the upper neck and closing by flexion, and neck disorders are found together with jaw disorders in a large share of patients. A jaw examination therefore includes a screen of the cervical spine and of head posture.
text.zh: 下颌并不是单独运动的。张口时上颈部伴有轻度后伸，闭口时伴有前屈；很大一部分下颌疾患的患者同时有颈部问题。因此下颌检查要包括颈椎和头部姿势的筛查。

overview.en: Temporomandibular disorders and how they are grouped, disc displacement and dislocation, a short examination of the jaw, facial palsy and the two cranial nerve screens, and eight acupoints around the joint with their local anatomy.
overview.zh: 颞下颌关节紊乱及其分类、关节盘移位与脱位、下颌的简要检查、面瘫与两条脑神经的筛查，以及关节周围 8 个穴位的局部解剖。

text.en: Temporomandibular disorders (TMD) are a group of conditions of the muscles of mastication, the temporomandibular joint, or both. Three findings define them: pain in the jaw, temple or in front of the ear; limited or uneven jaw movement; and joint sounds such as clicking or grating. Ear symptoms such as fullness or ringing are common companions.
text.zh: 颞下颌关节紊乱（TMD）是一组累及咀嚼肌、颞下颌关节或两者的疾病。三类表现是它的特征：下颌、颞部或耳前疼痛；张口受限或运动不对称；弹响或摩擦音等关节杂音。耳闷、耳鸣等耳部症状也常伴随出现。

text.en: TMD is the second most common musculoskeletal pain condition after chronic low back pain. About 5 to 12 percent of people have symptoms that need care, the peak age is 20 to 40 years, and women are affected two to three times as often as men. Teeth grinding (bruxism), stress, anxiety and trauma raise the risk; the role of the bite is unclear.
text.zh: TMD 是仅次于慢性腰痛的第二常见肌肉骨骼疼痛疾病。约 5%～12% 的人有需要处理的症状，高发年龄为 20～40 岁，女性发病是男性的 2～3 倍。磨牙症、精神压力、焦虑和外伤会增加风险；咬合的作用尚不明确。

rows.en: Masseter, temporalis and the other muscles of mastication
Aching in the cheek or temple that changes with chewing; the muscle is tender and pressing on it reproduces the familiar pain
rows.zh: 面颊或颞部酸痛，随咀嚼变化；肌肉压痛，按压可引出患者熟悉的疼痛

rows.en: The joint itself: capsule, disc, joint surfaces
rows.zh: 关节本身：关节囊、关节盘、关节面

rows.en: Pain in front of the ear; clicking with a displaced disc; grating (crepitus) with degenerative joint disease; locking or dislocation
rows.zh: 耳前疼痛；关节盘移位时有弹响；退行性关节病时有摩擦音；绞锁或脱位

rows.en: Headache in the temple that changes with jaw movement and is reproduced by pressing on temporalis
rows.zh: 颞部头痛，随下颌运动变化，按压颞肌可引出

text.en: The research standard for diagnosis, the Diagnostic Criteria for TMD (DC/TMD), has two axes: Axis I names the physical diagnosis and Axis II screens pain-related distress and disability. Its key idea for the clinic is familiar pain: palpation or movement must reproduce the pain the patient came with. The pain diagnoses made this way are reliable; a displaced disc can only be confirmed by imaging, except for the closed lock with limited opening.
text.zh: 诊断的研究标准是《颞下颌关节紊乱诊断标准》（DC/TMD），分两个轴：轴 I 给出躯体诊断，轴 II 筛查与疼痛相关的心理困扰和功能受限。对临床最有用的概念是“熟悉的疼痛”：触诊或运动必须引出患者就诊时的那种疼痛。这样得出的疼痛类诊断是可靠的；关节盘移位则要靠影像确认，只有伴张口受限的闭锁例外。

text.en: Most patients improve with conservative care, and up to 40 percent of symptoms settle on their own. First-line measures are education, a soft diet and resting the jaw from wide opening and clenching, heat, stretching and exercise, manual therapy and attention to posture. The evidence for occlusal splints is disputed.
text.zh: 多数患者经保守治疗好转，最多约 40% 的症状可自行缓解。首选措施包括健康教育、软食、避免大张口和紧咬、热敷、牵伸和运动训练、手法治疗以及姿势调整。咬合板的证据尚有争议。
4.2 关节盘移位与关节脱位

text.en: In a healthy joint the disc sits on top of the condyle and travels with it. In disc displacement the disc lies in front of the condyle when the mouth is closed. What happens next, as the mouth opens, separates the two main types. Displaced discs are also common in people without symptoms, so a click alone needs no treatment.
text.zh: 正常关节的关节盘盖在髁突上并随它移动。关节盘移位时，闭口状态下关节盘位于髁突前方。张口时接下来发生什么，区分出两种主要类型。没有症状的人也常有关节盘移位，所以单纯弹响不需要治疗。

paragraphs.en: As the mouth opens, the condyle slips under the posterior band and back onto the disc; the disc is recaptured (reduced). This produces a click or pop. A second, softer click may be heard on closing as the disc slips forward again.
paragraphs.zh: 张口时髁突滑过后带重新回到关节盘下方，关节盘被“复位”，发出弹响。闭口时关节盘再次滑到前方，可听到第二个较轻的弹响。

items.en: Opening range is normal.
items.zh: 张口度正常。

items.en: The chin swings toward the affected side until the click, then returns to the midline.
items.zh: 弹响之前颏部偏向患侧，弹响后回到中线。

items.en: An early click suggests a small displacement, a late click a larger one.
items.zh: 弹响出现得早提示移位小，出现得晚提示移位大。

heading.zh: 不可复性关节盘移位（闭锁）

paragraphs.en: The disc stays in front of the condyle and blocks translation, so only the rotation stage of opening is left. The click the patient used to have disappears.
paragraphs.zh: 关节盘一直留在髁突前方，挡住滑动，张口只剩转动阶段。患者原有的弹响消失。

items.en: Opening is limited, typically to 30 mm or less, when the lock is recent.
items.zh: 闭锁初期张口受限，通常不超过 30 mm。

items.en: The chin deflects toward the affected side and does not return.
items.zh: 颏部偏向患侧且不回到中线。

items.en: The retrodiscal tissue is stretched and loaded by the condyle, which is why the joint hurts.
items.zh: 盘后组织被拉长并受髁突挤压，所以关节疼痛。

items.en: Opening often improves over 6 to 12 months as the tissues adapt.
items.zh: 随着组织适应，张口度常在 6～12 个月内改善。

text.en: Dislocation is the opposite problem: too much translation. In a wide yawn or a large bite the condyle passes in front of the articular tubercle and is held there by spasm of masseter and medial pterygoid. The mouth is stuck open. It is reduced by pressing the lower molars downward and then guiding the mandible backward. A subluxation is the same event that the patient reduces alone.
text.zh: 脱位则是相反的问题：滑动过度。打大哈欠或大口咬东西时，髁突越过关节结节到其前方，并被咬肌和翼内肌的痉挛卡在那里，口张着合不上。复位方法是向下按压下磨牙，再把下颌骨向后引导。半脱位是同样的情况，但患者能自己复位。

text.en: 4.3 A short examination of the jaw

Ask where the pain is and have the patient point with one finger: in front of the ear suggests the joint, the cheek or temple suggests muscle. Ask about clicking, locking, clenching or grinding, and ear symptoms. Look at head posture and facial symmetry.
text.zh: 问疼痛部位，让患者用一根手指指出：耳前提示关节，面颊或颞部提示肌肉。询问弹响、绞锁、紧咬或磨牙以及耳部症状。观察头部姿势和面部对称性。

text.en: Measure between the upper and lower central incisors: pain-free opening, then maximum opening. Normal is about 40 to 50 mm. Try the three-finger screen.
text.zh: 在上下中切牙之间测量：先测无痛张口度，再测最大张口度。正常约 40～50 mm。可用三指法快速筛查。

text.en: Stand in front and watch the chin. Note whether it goes straight, swings to one side and stays, or curves away and returns, and whether a click coincides with the change.
text.zh: 站在患者正面看颏部。记录它是直线下降、偏向一侧不回，还是偏出后又回来，以及轨迹改变时是否伴有弹响。

text.en: Measure lateral excursion to each side between the midlines of the upper and lower teeth, then protrusion. Compare the two sides.
text.zh: 在上下牙中线之间分别测量向两侧的侧方运动，再测前伸。两侧对比。

text.en: Place the fingertips just in front of each tragus and ask the patient to open and close. Feel the condyles glide forward, compare the two sides, and note clicks, grating and tenderness.
text.zh: 把指尖放在两侧耳屏前方，让患者开闭口。感受髁突向前滑动，两侧对比，记录弹响、摩擦音和压痛。

text.en: Palpate masseter between the zygomatic arch and the angle of the mandible, and temporalis over the temple above the arch, with the jaw relaxed and then clenched. Ask each time whether the pain is the familiar one.
text.zh: 在颧弓与下颌角之间触诊咬肌，在颧弓上方的颞部触诊颞肌，分别在放松和咬紧时触诊。每次都问是不是“熟悉的疼痛”。

text.en: Check active movement of the cervical spine and head posture, because neck and jaw problems often occur together.
text.zh: 检查颈椎主动活动度和头部姿势，因为颈部和下颌问题常同时存在。

text.en: Weakness of one side of the face comes from a lesion somewhere along the facial nerve pathway. The first question is whether the forehead is involved, because that separates a lesion of the nerve itself from a lesion in the brain above it.
text.zh: 一侧面部无力来自面神经通路上某处的病变。首先要看前额是否受累，因为这一点把面神经本身的病变和它上方脑内的病变区分开来。

columns.zh: 周围性（下运动神经元）面瘫
中枢性（上运动神经元）面瘫

rows.en: Facial nerve or its nucleus, same side as the weakness
rows.zh: 面神经或面神经核，与面瘫同侧

rows.en: Brain above the nucleus, opposite side, for example a stroke
rows.zh: 面神经核以上的脑部，在面瘫对侧，例如脑卒中

rows.en: Weak: the patient cannot wrinkle the forehead or raise the eyebrow
rows.zh: 无力：不能皱额、不能抬眉

rows.en: Weak: drooping corner of the mouth
Weak: drooping corner of the mouth
All fibres to that half of the face are cut
rows.zh: 到这半侧面部的全部纤维都被阻断

rows.en: The part of the nucleus for the upper face receives input from both sides of the brain
rows.zh: 支配面上部的核团接受双侧大脑的纤维

text.en: Bell palsy is the most common peripheral facial palsy, about 70 percent of cases. It is idiopathic and a diagnosis of exclusion. One side of the face weakens over one to three days. Depending on how far up the nerve is affected, there may also be reduced taste, sounds that seem too loud and a dry eye. More than 70 percent of patients recover completely.
text.zh: 贝尔麻痹是最常见的周围性面瘫，约占 70%。它是特发性的，属于排除性诊断。一侧面部在 1～3 天内出现无力。按面神经受累位置的高低，还可出现味觉减退、听觉过敏和眼干。70% 以上的患者能完全恢复。

text.en: Two things are urgent. The first is the eye: an eye that cannot close dries out and the cornea can be damaged, so it needs lubricating drops by day and taping shut at night. The second is timing: a short course of corticosteroids is started within 72 hours of onset. Severity is graded with the House-Brackmann scale from I (normal) to VI (no movement). Facial exercises and massage are part of rehabilitation.
text.zh: 有两件事要抓紧。第一是眼睛：闭不上的眼会变干，角膜可能受损，白天要用人工泪液，晚上要用胶布把眼贴合。第二是时机：短程糖皮质激素要在发病 72 小时内开始。严重程度用 House-Brackmann 分级，从 I 级（正常）到 VI 级（完全不动）。面部运动训练和按摩是康复的一部分。

heading.en: When facial weakness is not Bell palsy
heading.zh: 哪些面瘫不是贝尔麻痹

paragraphs.en: These findings call for prompt medical review:
paragraphs.zh: 出现下列情况应尽快就医：

items.en: The forehead is spared: think of a stroke.
items.zh: 前额不受累：要考虑脑卒中。

items.en: The weakness progresses slowly over weeks: think of a tumour, including a mass in the parotid gland.
items.zh: 无力在数周内缓慢加重：要考虑肿瘤，包括腮腺肿块。

items.en: Blisters in or around the ear: think of Ramsay Hunt syndrome.
items.zh: 耳内或耳周出现疱疹：要考虑 Ramsay Hunt 综合征。

items.en: Both sides are weak: think of Lyme disease or Guillain-Barré syndrome.
items.zh: 双侧无力：要考虑莱姆病或吉兰-巴雷综合征。

rows.en: Light touch on the forehead (V1), cheek (V2) and chin (V3), comparing the two sides
rows.zh: 轻触前额（V1）、面颊（V2）和颏部（V3），两侧对比

rows.en: Clench the teeth while the examiner feels masseter and temporalis; open against resistance
rows.zh: 咬紧牙，检查者触摸咬肌和颞肌；抗阻张口

rows.en: Both sides contract firmly and equally
Raise the eyebrows, close the eyes tightly, smile, puff out the cheeks, show the lower teeth
rows.zh: 抬眉、用力闭眼、微笑、鼓腮、露出下牙

text.zh: 4.6 颞下颌关节周围的穴位

text.en: Eight points lie on the structures of this chapter. Three sit in a vertical row in front of the ear, over the back of the joint: TE21, SI19 and GB2. ST7 lies over the mandibular notch, ST6 on the belly of masseter, SI18 below the zygomatic bone, ST4 at the corner of the mouth and TE17 behind the ear lobe where the facial nerve leaves the skull. Locations follow the national standard GB/T 12346-2021; the English wording is from the WHO 2008 standard where that text could be read and is otherwise a translation.
text.zh: 有 8 个穴位落在本章讲到的结构上。其中三个在耳前排成一条竖线，位于关节后方：耳门（TE21）、听宫（SI19）和听会（GB2）。下关（ST7）在下颌切迹表面，颊车（ST6）在咬肌肌腹上，颧髎（SI18）在颧骨下方，地仓（ST4）在口角旁，翳风（TE17）在耳垂后方、面神经出颅处。定位依照国家标准 GB/T 12346-2021；英文表述在能读到 WHO 2008 标准原文的地方采用原文，其余为译文。

heading.en: How to read the acupoint entries

paragraphs.en: This is a learning reference only and does not indicate needle depth, direction or path. The layers describe what lies under the surface point, so that the point can be linked to the anatomy of this chapter.
paragraphs.zh: 此处仅作学习参照，不表示进针深度、方向或路径。“层次”一栏写的是体表点下方有什么结构，用来把穴位和本章的解剖联系起来。

overview.en: Memory cues, nine questions with complete answers, and what the daily pushes of this week will add.
overview.zh: 口诀、9 道带完整答案的问答，以及本周每日推送要补的内容。

text.en: Three muscles of mastication close the jaw (masseter, temporalis, medial pterygoid); only the lateral pterygoid opens it.
text.zh: 三块咀嚼肌闭口（咬肌、颞肌、翼内肌），只有翼外肌张口。

blocks.original: 咬颞翼内三闭口，翼外一块管张口。

text.en: Opening is rotation in the lower compartment first, then translation in the upper compartment.
text.zh: 张口先是下腔的转动，再是上腔的滑动。

text.en: The three divisions of the trigeminal nerve leave through the Superior orbital fissure, foramen Rotundum and foramen Ovale; the English mnemonic is "Standing Room Only".
text.zh: 三叉神经三个分支分别经眶上裂、圆孔、卵圆孔出颅；英文口诀是 Standing Room Only。

blocks.original: 眼走眶上裂，上颌走圆孔，下颌走卵圆孔。

text.en: The five terminal branches of the facial nerve from top to bottom are temporal, zygomatic, buccal, marginal mandibular and cervical; the English mnemonic is "To Zanzibar By Motor Car".
text.zh: 面神经五条终末支从上到下是颞支、颧支、颊支、下颌缘支和颈支；英文口诀是 To Zanzibar By Motor Car。

blocks.original: 颞颧颊，下颌缘，颈支在最下。

text.en: A peripheral facial palsy weakens the forehead; a central facial palsy spares it.
text.zh: 周围性面瘫前额受累；中枢性面瘫前额不受累。

blocks.original: 周围瘫全脸，中枢留额头。

text.en: Three points line up in front of the ear from top to bottom: TE21, SI19, GB2.
text.zh: 耳前三个穴位从上到下排成一线：耳门、听宫、听会。

blocks.original: 耳前三穴：门、宫、会，从上往下排。

text.en: 5.3 What the daily pushes this week will fill in
text.zh: 5.3 本周每日推送要补的内容

text.en: Monday adds four more points of the face that are not in this chapter and drills the muscles of mastication; Tuesday walks through a temporomandibular disorder from examination to treatment; Wednesday is a teaching case of a closed lock; Thursday reads the paper that set the diagnostic criteria for temporomandibular disorders; Friday practises the jaw examination and the cranial nerve screens; Saturday is the weekly quiz and spaced review.
text.zh: 周一补 4 个本章没有讲的面部穴位并练咀嚼肌；周二讲颞下颌关节紊乱从检查到治疗的全过程；周三是一个关节盘闭锁的教学案例；周四精读制定颞下颌关节紊乱诊断标准的那篇论文；周五练下颌检查和脑神经筛查；周六是本周小测和间隔复习。

origin.en: Superficial part: maxillary process of the zygomatic bone and the anterior two-thirds of the zygomatic arch. Deep part: medial surface and inferior margin of the zygomatic arch (one description limits it to the posterior third and adds the fascia over temporalis)
origin.zh: 浅部：颧骨上颌突和颧弓前三分之二。深部：颧弓内侧面和下缘（有资料只写后三分之一，并加上颞肌表面的筋膜）

insertion.en: Superficial part: lateral surface of the angle and lower half of the ramus of the mandible. Deep part: upper part of the ramus and the lateral surface of the coronoid process
insertion.zh: 浅部：下颌角外侧面和下颌支下半。深部：下颌支上部和冠突外侧面

course.en: The masseter originates from the zygomatic bone and the zygomatic arch, passes downward on the lateral side of the ramus (superficial fibres run inferiorly and posteriorly, deep fibres run vertically), and inserts onto the lateral surface of the ramus, the angle and the coronoid process of the mandible. It is innervated by the masseteric nerve from the anterior division of the mandibular nerve (CN V3) and contributes to elevation of the mandible.
course.zh: 咬肌起自颧骨和颧弓，在下颌支外侧向下走行（浅部纤维向后下方，深部纤维垂直向下），止于下颌支外侧面、下颌角和冠突。它由下颌神经（CN V3）前干的咬肌神经支配，参与上提下颌骨。

actions.en: Elevates the mandible and clenches the teeth. The superficial fibres add a small amount of protrusion; the deep (and intermediate) fibres are described as retracting the mandible. It also helps keep the capsule of the temporomandibular joint under steady tension.
actions.zh: 上提下颌骨、咬紧牙齿。浅部纤维可稍微前伸下颌，深部（及中间部）纤维被描述为后缩下颌。它还帮助维持颞下颌关节囊的张力。

innervation.en: Masseteric nerve, from the anterior division of the mandibular nerve (CN V3); it crosses the mandibular notch to enter the deep surface of the muscle and gives an articular branch to the temporomandibular joint
innervation.zh: 咬肌神经，发自下颌神经（CN V3）前干；它跨过下颌切迹进入咬肌深面，并发出关节支到颞下颌关节

modelUnavailableReason.en: The bundled 3D model has no skull and none of the four muscles of mastication; adding them needs the owner's approval (see the chapter record).
modelUnavailableReason.zh: 自带 3D 模型没有颅骨，也没有四块咀嚼肌；补上它们需要先经用户同意（见本章制作记录）。

origin.en: Floor of the temporal fossa below the inferior temporal line, and the deep surface of the temporal fascia
origin.zh: 颞下线以下的颞窝骨面，以及颞筋膜深面

insertion.en: Apex and medial surface of the coronoid process and the anterior border of the ramus of the mandible
insertion.zh: 下颌骨冠突尖和内侧面，以及下颌支前缘

course.en: The temporalis originates from the temporal fossa and the deep surface of the temporal fascia, passes downward as a fan whose fibres converge on a tendon deep to the zygomatic arch, and inserts onto the coronoid process and the anterior border of the ramus of the mandible. It is innervated by the deep temporal nerves from the anterior division of the mandibular nerve (CN V3) and contributes to elevation and retraction of the mandible.
course.zh: 颞肌起自颞窝和颞筋膜深面，呈扇形向下走行，纤维汇聚成腱，从颧弓深面通过，止于下颌骨冠突和下颌支前缘。它由下颌神经（CN V3）前干的颞深神经支配，参与上提和后缩下颌骨。

actions.en: The anterior, nearly vertical fibres elevate the mandible; the posterior, nearly horizontal fibres pull it backward (retraction). Acting on one side, it takes part in side-to-side grinding movements.
actions.zh: 前部近垂直的纤维上提下颌骨；后部近水平的纤维把下颌骨拉向后方（后缩）。单侧收缩时参与左右研磨动作。

innervation.en: Deep temporal nerves (anterior and posterior; a middle branch is also described), from the anterior division of the mandibular nerve (CN V3)
innervation.zh: 颞深神经（前、后两支，也有资料另列中间支），发自下颌神经（CN V3）前干

modelUnavailableReason.en: The bundled 3D model has no skull and none of the four muscles of mastication; adding them needs the owner's approval (see the chapter record).
modelUnavailableReason.zh: 自带 3D 模型没有颅骨，也没有四块咀嚼肌；补上它们需要先经用户同意（见本章制作记录）。

origin.en: Deep head (the bulk of the muscle): medial surface of the lateral pterygoid plate of the sphenoid and the pyramidal process of the palatine bone. Superficial head: tuberosity of the maxilla and the pyramidal process of the palatine bone
origin.zh: 深头（肌的主体）：蝶骨翼突外侧板内侧面和腭骨锥突。浅头：上颌结节和腭骨锥突

insertion.en: Medial surface of the ramus and angle of the mandible (pterygoid tuberosity), from the mandibular foramen above down to the mylohyoid groove
insertion.zh: 下颌支和下颌角内侧面（翼肌粗隆），范围自下颌孔向下至下颌舌骨沟

course.en: The medial pterygoid originates from the medial surface of the lateral pterygoid plate, the palatine bone and the tuberosity of the maxilla, passes downward, backward and laterally on the inner side of the ramus, and inserts onto the medial surface of the ramus and angle of the mandible. It is innervated by the nerve to medial pterygoid from the main trunk of the mandibular nerve (CN V3) and contributes to elevation of the mandible.
course.zh: 翼内肌起自翼突外侧板内侧面、腭骨和上颌结节，在下颌支内侧向后下外方走行，止于下颌支和下颌角内侧面。它由下颌神经（CN V3）主干发出的翼内肌神经支配，参与上提下颌骨。

actions.en: Both sides together elevate the mandible with the masseter and, with the lateral pterygoids, protrude it. One side acting with the lateral pterygoid of the same side swings that side of the mandible forward and medially, so the chin moves to the opposite side; alternating sides produces grinding.
actions.zh: 两侧同时收缩时与咬肌一起上提下颌骨，并与翼外肌一起前伸下颌。单侧与同侧翼外肌一起收缩时，把这一侧下颌骨拉向前内，颏部移向对侧；两侧交替收缩产生研磨动作。

innervation.en: Nerve to medial pterygoid, from the main trunk of the mandibular nerve (CN V3) before it divides; the same nerve supplies tensor veli palatini and tensor tympani
innervation.zh: 翼内肌神经，发自下颌神经（CN V3）分叉之前的主干；同一条神经还支配腭帆张肌和鼓膜张肌

modelUnavailableReason.en: The bundled 3D model has no skull and none of the four muscles of mastication; adding them needs the owner's approval (see the chapter record).
modelUnavailableReason.zh: 自带 3D 模型没有颅骨，也没有四块咀嚼肌；补上它们需要先经用户同意（见本章制作记录）。

origin.en: Superior head: infratemporal surface and infratemporal crest of the greater wing of the sphenoid. Inferior head (about three times larger): lateral surface of the lateral pterygoid plate
origin.zh: 上头：蝶骨大翼的颞下面和颞下嵴。下头（约为上头的三倍大）：翼突外侧板外侧面

insertion.en: Pterygoid fovea on the neck of the condylar process of the mandible; some fibres of the superior head reach the capsule and articular disc of the temporomandibular joint
insertion.zh: 下颌骨髁突颈的翼肌凹；上头的部分纤维止于颞下颌关节囊和关节盘

course.en: The lateral pterygoid originates from the greater wing of the sphenoid and the lateral surface of the lateral pterygoid plate, passes almost horizontally backward and laterally, and inserts onto the pterygoid fovea on the neck of the mandible, with some superior fibres attaching to the joint capsule and articular disc. It is innervated by the nerve to lateral pterygoid from the anterior division of the mandibular nerve (CN V3) and contributes to protrusion and depression of the mandible and to movement of the chin to the opposite side.
course.zh: 翼外肌起自蝶骨大翼和翼突外侧板外侧面，几乎水平地向后外方走行，止于下颌颈的翼肌凹，上头的部分纤维附着于关节囊和关节盘。它由下颌神经（CN V3）前干的翼外肌神经支配，参与下颌骨的前伸、下降，以及颏部向对侧的移动。

actions.en: Both sides together pull the condyles and discs forward, protruding the mandible and opening the mouth; it is the only muscle of mastication that depresses the mandible. One side alone moves the chin to the opposite side. The role of the superior head is debated: older teaching makes it active in closing, while more recent descriptions find the two heads working alike.
actions.zh: 两侧同时收缩时把髁突和关节盘拉向前方，使下颌前伸并张口；它是咀嚼肌中唯一下降下颌骨的肌。单侧收缩时使颏部移向对侧。上头的作用有争议：旧的说法认为它在闭口时活动，较新的描述认为上下两头的作用相似。

innervation.en: Nerve to lateral pterygoid, from the anterior division of the mandibular nerve (CN V3), with a branch to each head; a variant supply of the superior head from the buccal nerve is described
innervation.zh: 翼外肌神经，发自下颌神经（CN V3）前干，上下两头各有分支；有资料描述上头由颊神经支配的变异

modelUnavailableReason.en: The bundled 3D model has no skull and none of the four muscles of mastication; adding them needs the owner's approval (see the chapter record).
modelUnavailableReason.zh: 自带 3D 模型没有颅骨，也没有四块咀嚼肌；补上它们需要先经用户同意（见本章制作记录）。

origin.en: Anterior belly: digastric fossa on the inner side of the lower border of the mandible, near the midline. Posterior belly: mastoid notch on the medial side of the mastoid process of the temporal bone
origin.zh: 前腹：下颌骨下缘内侧、靠近正中线的二腹肌窝。后腹：颞骨乳突内侧的乳突切迹

insertion.en: Intermediate tendon, held to the body of the hyoid bone (near its junction with the greater horn) by a fibrous sling that works as a pulley
insertion.zh: 中间腱，由一条起滑车作用的纤维环系于舌骨体（靠近体与大角交界处）

course.en: The digastric originates from the digastric fossa of the mandible (anterior belly) and from the mastoid notch of the temporal bone (posterior belly), passes toward the hyoid bone, where the posterior belly pierces the stylohyoid, and inserts onto an intermediate tendon that attaches to the body of the hyoid bone through a fibrous sling. It is innervated by the nerve to mylohyoid from the mandibular nerve, CN V3 (anterior belly) and by the digastric branch of the facial nerve, CN VII (posterior belly) and contributes to depression of the mandible and elevation of the hyoid bone.
course.zh: 二腹肌的前腹起自下颌骨二腹肌窝，后腹起自颞骨乳突切迹，两腹都走向舌骨，后腹在途中穿过茎突舌骨肌，止于中间腱，中间腱借纤维环附着于舌骨体。前腹由下颌神经（CN V3）的下颌舌骨肌神经支配，后腹由面神经（CN VII）的二腹肌支支配；它参与下降下颌骨和上提舌骨。

actions.en: With the hyoid bone held steady from below, it depresses the mandible and helps open the mouth, and is also described as drawing the chin backward. With the mandible fixed, it raises the hyoid bone and larynx during swallowing.
actions.zh: 舌骨被下方的肌固定时，它下降下颌骨、协助张口，也被描述为把颏部拉向后方。下颌骨固定时，它在吞咽中上提舌骨和喉。

innervation.en: Anterior belly: nerve to mylohyoid, a branch of the inferior alveolar nerve (mandibular nerve, CN V3). Posterior belly: digastric branch of the facial nerve (CN VII)
innervation.zh: 前腹：下颌舌骨肌神经，为下牙槽神经（下颌神经，CN V3）的分支。后腹：面神经（CN VII）的二腹肌支

modelUnavailableReason.en: The bundled 3D model shows this muscle as two separate meshes, the anterior belly and the posterior belly; the links in the text open each belly.
modelUnavailableReason.zh: 自带 3D 模型把这块肌分成前腹和后腹两块网格；正文里的链接分别打开前腹和后腹。

origin.en: Whole length of the mylohyoid line on the inner surface of the body of the mandible
origin.zh: 下颌体内面的下颌舌骨线全长

insertion.en: Median mylohyoid raphe (anterior fibres) and the body of the hyoid bone (posterior fibres)
insertion.zh: 正中的下颌舌骨肌缝（前部纤维）和舌骨体（后部纤维）

course.en: The mylohyoid originates from the mylohyoid line of the mandible, passes medially and downward as a flat sheet that meets its partner in the midline, and inserts onto the mylohyoid raphe and the body of the hyoid bone. It is innervated by the nerve to mylohyoid, a branch of the inferior alveolar nerve from the mandibular nerve (CN V3), and contributes to elevation of the hyoid bone and the floor of the mouth.
course.zh: 下颌舌骨肌起自下颌骨的下颌舌骨线，呈扁平肌片向内下方走行，在正中线与对侧会合，止于下颌舌骨肌缝和舌骨体。它由下颌舌骨肌神经（下颌神经 CN V3 的下牙槽神经分支）支配，参与上提舌骨和口底。

actions.en: Forms the muscular floor of the mouth. With the mandible fixed, it raises the hyoid bone and the floor of the mouth and presses the tongue against the palate in swallowing. With the hyoid bone fixed, it helps depress the mandible.
actions.zh: 构成口底的肌性底。下颌骨固定时，它上提舌骨和口底，在吞咽中把舌压向腭。舌骨固定时，它协助下降下颌骨。

innervation.en: Nerve to mylohyoid, a branch of the inferior alveolar nerve (mandibular nerve, CN V3)
innervation.zh: 下颌舌骨肌神经，为下牙槽神经（下颌神经，CN V3）的分支

origin.en: Inferior mental spine (inferior genial tubercle) on the back of the mandibular symphysis
origin.zh: 下颌联合后面的下颏棘

insertion.en: Anterior surface of the body of the hyoid bone

course.en: The geniohyoid originates from the inferior mental spine of the mandible, passes backward and slightly downward close to the midline, deep to the mylohyoid, and inserts onto the body of the hyoid bone. It is innervated by fibres of the C1 spinal nerve that travel with the hypoglossal nerve (CN XII) and contributes to drawing the hyoid bone upward and forward.
course.zh: 颏舌骨肌起自下颌骨下颏棘，在下颌舌骨肌深面、靠近正中线向后并略向下走行，止于舌骨体。它由随舌下神经（CN XII）走行的 C1 脊神经纤维支配，参与把舌骨拉向前上方。

actions.en: Draws the hyoid bone upward and forward, which widens the airway. With the hyoid bone fixed, it helps depress the mandible and open the mouth.
actions.zh: 把舌骨拉向前上方，使气道增宽。舌骨固定时，它协助下降下颌骨、张口。

innervation.en: Anterior ramus of the C1 spinal nerve, carried by the hypoglossal nerve (CN XII)
innervation.zh: C1 脊神经前支，纤维随舌下神经（CN XII）走行

origin.en: Posterior surface of the styloid process of the temporal bone, near its base
origin.zh: 颞骨茎突后面，靠近茎突根部

insertion.en: Body of the hyoid bone at its junction with the greater horn

course.en: The stylohyoid originates from the styloid process of the temporal bone, passes downward and forward alongside the posterior belly of the digastric, splitting near its end to let the digastric tendon through, and inserts onto the body of the hyoid bone at its junction with the greater horn. It is innervated by the stylohyoid branch of the facial nerve (CN VII) and contributes to drawing the hyoid bone upward and backward.
course.zh: 茎突舌骨肌起自颞骨茎突，沿二腹肌后腹向前下方走行，在接近止点处分成两束让二腹肌中间腱穿过，止于舌骨体与大角交界处。它由面神经（CN VII）的茎突舌骨肌支支配，参与把舌骨拉向后上方。

actions.en: Draws the hyoid bone upward and backward at the start of swallowing and lengthens the floor of the mouth.
actions.zh: 在吞咽开始时把舌骨拉向后上方，并拉长口底。

innervation.en: Stylohyoid branch of the facial nerve (CN VII)
innervation.zh: 面神经（CN VII）的茎突舌骨肌支

origin.en: Frontal belly: skin of the eyebrow and the muscles of the forehead (no bony attachment). Occipital belly: lateral two-thirds of the superior nuchal line of the occipital bone
origin.zh: 额腹：眉部皮肤和额部肌（没有骨性附着）。枕腹：枕骨上项线外侧三分之二

insertion.en: Epicranial aponeurosis (galea aponeurotica): the frontal belly joins it in front of the coronal suture, the occipital belly behind the lambdoid suture
insertion.zh: 帽状腱膜：额腹在冠状缝前方、枕腹在人字缝后方与它相连

course.en: The occipitofrontalis originates from the skin of the eyebrow (frontal belly) and from the superior nuchal line of the occipital bone (occipital belly), passes over the vault of the skull between the scalp and the periosteum, and inserts onto the epicranial aponeurosis that joins the two bellies. It is innervated by the temporal branches (frontal belly) and the posterior auricular nerve (occipital belly) of the facial nerve (CN VII) and contributes to raising the eyebrows and wrinkling the forehead.
course.zh: 枕额肌的额腹起自眉部皮肤，枕腹起自枕骨上项线，在头皮与颅骨骨膜之间越过颅顶，止于连接两腹的帽状腱膜。额腹由面神经（CN VII）的颞支支配，枕腹由面神经的耳后神经支配；它参与抬眉和皱额。

actions.en: The frontal belly raises the eyebrows and wrinkles the forehead; the occipital belly draws the scalp backward.
actions.zh: 额腹抬眉、使前额出现横纹；枕腹把头皮拉向后方。

innervation.en: Facial nerve (CN VII): temporal branches to the frontal belly, posterior auricular nerve to the occipital belly
innervation.zh: 面神经（CN VII）：颞支支配额腹，耳后神经支配枕腹

modelUnavailableReason.en: The bundled 3D model has no occipitofrontalis; adding it needs the owner's approval (see the chapter record).
modelUnavailableReason.zh: 自带 3D 模型没有枕额肌；补上它需要先经用户同意（见本章制作记录）。

origin.en: Medial orbital margin, the medial palpebral ligament and the lacrimal bone
origin.zh: 眶内侧缘、睑内侧韧带和泪骨

insertion.en: Skin around the margin of the orbit and the tarsal plates of the eyelids
insertion.zh: 眶缘周围的皮肤和眼睑的睑板

course.en: The orbicularis oculi originates from the medial orbital margin, the medial palpebral ligament and the lacrimal bone, passes around the orbit as a ring that extends into both eyelids, and inserts onto the skin around the orbital margin and the tarsal plates. It is innervated by the temporal and zygomatic branches of the facial nerve (CN VII) and contributes to closing the eyelids.
course.zh: 眼轮匝肌起自眶内侧缘、睑内侧韧带和泪骨，呈环形围绕眼眶并伸入上下眼睑，止于眶缘周围的皮肤和睑板。它由面神经（CN VII）的颞支和颧支支配，参与闭合眼睑。

actions.en: The palpebral part closes the eyelids gently, as in blinking; the orbital part closes them tightly; the lacrimal part helps drain tears. It is the only muscle that closes the eyelids.
actions.zh: 睑部轻轻闭合眼睑（如眨眼）；眶部用力紧闭眼睑；泪部协助泪液引流。它是唯一闭合眼睑的肌。

innervation.en: Temporal and zygomatic branches of the facial nerve (CN VII)
innervation.zh: 面神经（CN VII）的颞支和颧支

modelUnavailableReason.en: The bundled 3D model shows this muscle as two separate meshes, the orbital part and the palpebral part; the links in the text open each part.
modelUnavailableReason.zh: 自带 3D 模型把这块肌分成眶部和睑部两块网格；正文里的链接分别打开这两部分。

origin.en: Lateral surface of the zygomatic bone

insertion.en: Angle of the mouth, where it blends with the other muscles at the modiolus
insertion.zh: 口角，在蜗轴处与其他肌交织

course.en: The zygomaticus major originates from the lateral surface of the zygomatic bone, passes downward and medially across the masseter and buccinator, and inserts onto the angle of the mouth at the modiolus. It is innervated by the zygomatic and buccal branches of the facial nerve (CN VII) and contributes to drawing the angle of the mouth upward and laterally.
course.zh: 颧大肌起自颧骨外侧面，越过咬肌和颊肌表面向内下方走行，止于口角的蜗轴。它由面神经（CN VII）的颧支和颊支支配，参与把口角拉向外上方。

actions.en: Pulls the angle of the mouth upward and laterally; with risorius it produces a smile.
actions.zh: 把口角拉向外上方；与笑肌一起产生微笑。

innervation.en: Zygomatic and buccal branches of the facial nerve (CN VII)
innervation.zh: 面神经（CN VII）的颧支和颊支

origin.en: Modiolus at each angle of the mouth and the surrounding muscles, mainly the buccinator, with small slips from the medial parts of the maxilla and mandible
origin.zh: 两侧口角的蜗轴和周围的肌（主要是颊肌），另有小束起自上颌骨和下颌骨内侧部

insertion.en: Skin and mucous membrane of the lips

course.en: The orbicularis oris originates from the modiolus at the angle of the mouth and from the neighbouring muscles, passes medially through the upper and lower lips as a ring around the mouth, and inserts onto the skin and mucous membrane of the lips. It is innervated by the buccal and marginal mandibular branches of the facial nerve (CN VII) and contributes to closing the mouth and protruding the lips.
course.zh: 口轮匝肌起自口角的蜗轴和邻近的肌，呈环形穿过上下唇向内侧走行，止于唇的皮肤和黏膜。它由面神经（CN VII）的颊支和下颌缘支支配，参与闭口和撅唇。

actions.en: Closes the mouth and compresses or protrudes the lips, as in pursing or whistling; with the buccinator it keeps food between the teeth.
actions.zh: 闭口，压紧或撅起嘴唇（如噘嘴、吹口哨）；与颊肌一起把食物留在上下牙之间。

innervation.en: Buccal and marginal mandibular branches of the facial nerve (CN VII); one summary lists the buccal branch only
innervation.zh: 面神经（CN VII）的颊支和下颌缘支；有的简表只列颊支

origin.en: Alveolar processes of the maxilla and mandible opposite the molar teeth, and the anterior margin of the pterygomandibular raphe
origin.zh: 上颌骨和下颌骨磨牙对应处的牙槽突，以及翼突下颌缝前缘

insertion.en: Modiolus at the angle of the mouth, where its fibres continue into the orbicularis oris of the upper and lower lips
insertion.zh: 口角的蜗轴，纤维在此延续为上下唇的口轮匝肌

course.en: The buccinator originates from the alveolar processes of the maxilla and mandible opposite the molar teeth and from the pterygomandibular raphe, passes forward in the wall of the cheek, where the parotid duct pierces it opposite the upper molars, and inserts onto the modiolus at the angle of the mouth. It is innervated by the buccal branches of the facial nerve (CN VII) and contributes to pressing the cheek against the teeth during chewing.
course.zh: 颊肌起自上颌骨、下颌骨磨牙对应处的牙槽突和翼突下颌缝，在颊壁内向前走行，腮腺管在上颌磨牙对应处穿过它，止于口角的蜗轴。它由面神经（CN VII）的颊支支配，参与在咀嚼时把颊压向牙齿。

actions.en: Keeps the cheek taut and presses it against the teeth so that food stays between the molars; it also expels air from the mouth, as in blowing a trumpet.
actions.zh: 保持颊部紧张并把颊压向牙齿，使食物留在磨牙之间；也能把口腔里的气体吹出，如吹小号。

innervation.en: Buccal branches of the facial nerve (CN VII). The buccal nerve of the mandibular nerve (CN V3) only carries sensation from the cheek
innervation.zh: 面神经（CN VII）的颊支。下颌神经（CN V3）的颊神经只管颊部的感觉

modelUnavailableReason.en: The bundled 3D model spells this muscle "Bucinator", so the muscle card has no button; the link in the text opens it.
modelUnavailableReason.zh: 自带 3D 模型把这块肌拼作 Bucinator，所以肌肉卡片不显示按钮；正文里的链接可以打开它。

origin.en: Skin and fascia over the upper parts of pectoralis major and deltoid, below and above the clavicle
origin.zh: 锁骨上下、胸大肌和三角肌上部表面的皮肤和筋膜

insertion.en: Lower border of the mandible, and the skin and muscles around the lower lip and angle of the mouth
insertion.zh: 下颌骨下缘，以及下唇和口角周围的皮肤和肌

course.en: The platysma originates from the skin and fascia over the upper chest and shoulder, passes upward and medially in the superficial fascia of the front and side of the neck, and inserts onto the lower border of the mandible and the skin around the lower lip and angle of the mouth. It is innervated by the cervical branch of the facial nerve (CN VII) and contributes to tensing the skin of the neck and lowering the mandible and the angle of the mouth.
course.zh: 颈阔肌起自上胸部和肩部表面的皮肤和筋膜，在颈前外侧的浅筋膜内向内上方走行，止于下颌骨下缘以及下唇和口角周围的皮肤。它由面神经（CN VII）的颈支支配，参与绷紧颈部皮肤、下降下颌骨和口角。

actions.en: Tenses the skin of the lower face and front of the neck and draws the mandible and the angle of the mouth downward.
actions.zh: 绷紧面下部和颈前部的皮肤，并把下颌骨和口角拉向下方。

innervation.en: Cervical branch of the facial nerve (CN VII)

description.en: The mandibular fossa is the hollow on the underside of the temporal bone that receives the head of the mandible. It is the posterior, concave part of the temporal joint surface; the articular tubercle bounds it in front. With the mouth closed, the condyle sits centred in the fossa.
description.zh: 下颌窝是颞骨下面容纳下颌头的凹陷，是颞骨关节面后方的凹面部分，前界为关节结节。闭口时髁突位于下颌窝中央。

modelUnavailableReason.en: The bundled 3D model has no skull bones, so this landmark cannot be opened in 3D yet.
modelUnavailableReason.zh: 自带 3D 模型没有颅骨，这个骨性标志暂时不能在 3D 中打开。

description.en: The articular tubercle (articular eminence) is the rounded ridge at the root of the zygomatic process of the temporal bone, forming the anterior boundary of the mandibular fossa. The condyle and disc slide forward onto it when the mouth opens wide, and it restrains excessive forward movement of the mandible.
description.zh: 关节结节（关节隆起）是颞骨颧突根部的圆形隆起，构成下颌窝的前界。大张口时髁突和关节盘向前滑到它的下方；它限制下颌骨过度前移。

modelUnavailableReason.en: The bundled 3D model has no skull bones, so this landmark cannot be opened in 3D yet.
modelUnavailableReason.zh: 自带 3D 模型没有颅骨，这个骨性标志暂时不能在 3D 中打开。

description.en: The postglenoid tubercle (postglenoid process) is the small bony lip behind the mandibular fossa, in front of the external acoustic meatus. Together with the lateral ligament it resists backward displacement of the condyle, which is why posterior dislocation is very rare.
description.zh: 关节后结节（关节后突）是下颌窝后方、外耳道前方的小骨性突起。它与外侧韧带一起阻挡髁突向后移位，所以后脱位非常少见。

modelUnavailableReason.en: The bundled 3D model has no skull bones, so this landmark cannot be opened in 3D yet.
modelUnavailableReason.zh: 自带 3D 模型没有颅骨，这个骨性标志暂时不能在 3D 中打开。

description.en: The zygomatic arch is the bony bridge formed by the zygomatic process of the temporal bone and the temporal process of the zygomatic bone. The temporal fascia attaches along its upper border and the masseter arises from its lower border and deep surface; the gap deep to the arch lets the temporalis tendon pass from the temporal fossa to the coronoid process.
description.zh: 颧弓是由颞骨颧突和颧骨颞突连成的骨桥。颞筋膜附着于它的上缘，咬肌起自它的下缘和深面；颧弓深面的间隙让颞肌腱从颞窝下行到冠突。

modelUnavailableReason.en: The bundled 3D model has no skull bones, so this landmark cannot be opened in 3D yet.
modelUnavailableReason.zh: 自带 3D 模型没有颅骨，这个骨性标志暂时不能在 3D 中打开。

description.en: The mastoid process is the downward projection of the temporal bone that can be felt behind the ear. Sternocleidomastoid attaches to it, and the posterior belly of the digastric arises from the mastoid notch on its medial side.
description.zh: 乳突是颞骨向下的突起，在耳后可以摸到。胸锁乳突肌附着于它，二腹肌后腹起自它内侧的乳突切迹。

modelUnavailableReason.en: The bundled 3D model has no skull bones, so this landmark cannot be opened in 3D yet.
modelUnavailableReason.zh: 自带 3D 模型没有颅骨，这个骨性标志暂时不能在 3D 中打开。

description.en: The styloid process is the slender spike of the temporal bone just below the opening of the external acoustic meatus. It gives origin to the stylohyoid muscle and to the stylomandibular ligament; the facial nerve leaves the skull through the stylomastoid foramen just behind it.
description.zh: 茎突是颞骨的细长骨刺，位于外耳道口的正下方。茎突舌骨肌和茎突下颌韧带起自茎突；面神经从紧靠茎突后方的茎乳孔出颅。

modelUnavailableReason.en: The bundled 3D model has no skull bones, so this landmark cannot be opened in 3D yet.
modelUnavailableReason.zh: 自带 3D 模型没有颅骨，这个骨性标志暂时不能在 3D 中打开。

description.en: The condylar process is the posterior of the two upward projections of the ramus. Its head (the condyle) is elliptical, long from side to side (about 15–20 mm) and short from front to back (about 8–10 mm), and articulates with the temporal bone through the articular disc; the narrower neck below it carries the pterygoid fovea. Neck fractures usually come with dislocation of the temporomandibular joint.
description.zh: 髁突是下颌支向上两个突起中靠后的一个。它的头（髁状突）呈椭圆形，左右径长（约 15–20 mm）、前后径短（约 8–10 mm），隔着关节盘与颞骨相关节；头下方较细的颈部有翼肌凹。髁突颈骨折通常伴有颞下颌关节脱位。

modelUnavailableReason.en: The bundled 3D model has no skull bones, so this landmark cannot be opened in 3D yet.
modelUnavailableReason.zh: 自带 3D 模型没有颅骨，这个骨性标志暂时不能在 3D 中打开。

description.en: The pterygoid fovea is the small depression on the front of the neck of the condylar process where the lateral pterygoid inserts. The joint capsule attaches to the condyle just above it.
description.zh: 翼肌凹是髁突颈前面的小凹陷，翼外肌止于此处。关节囊附着于紧靠它上方的髁突。

modelUnavailableReason.en: The bundled 3D model has no skull bones, so this landmark cannot be opened in 3D yet.
modelUnavailableReason.zh: 自带 3D 模型没有颅骨，这个骨性标志暂时不能在 3D 中打开。

description.en: The coronoid process is the thin, triangular anterior projection of the ramus. Temporalis inserts on its apex and medial surface, and the deep part of the masseter reaches its lateral surface. With the mouth closed it lies hidden deep to the zygomatic arch.
description.zh: 冠突是下颌支前方薄而呈三角形的突起。颞肌止于冠突尖和内侧面，咬肌深部到达它的外侧面。闭口时它藏在颧弓深面。

modelUnavailableReason.en: The bundled 3D model has no skull bones, so this landmark cannot be opened in 3D yet.
modelUnavailableReason.zh: 自带 3D 模型没有颅骨，这个骨性标志暂时不能在 3D 中打开。

description.en: The mandibular notch (sigmoid notch) is the curved gap between the coronoid process and the condylar process. The masseteric nerve and vessels cross it to reach the deep surface of the masseter. The point ST7 (Xiaguan) lies in the hollow between the notch and the lower border of the zygomatic arch.
description.zh: 下颌切迹（乙状切迹）是冠突与髁突之间的弧形缺口。咬肌神经和血管跨过它到达咬肌深面。下关（ST7）就在下颌切迹与颧弓下缘之间的凹陷中。

modelUnavailableReason.en: The bundled 3D model has no skull bones, so this landmark cannot be opened in 3D yet.
modelUnavailableReason.zh: 自带 3D 模型没有颅骨，这个骨性标志暂时不能在 3D 中打开。

description.en: The ramus is the vertical plate of the mandible that rises from the back of the body and ends above in the coronoid and condylar processes. The masseter covers its lateral surface and the medial pterygoid its medial surface, and it forms the lateral wall of the infratemporal fossa.
description.zh: 下颌支是下颌骨的垂直骨板，自下颌体后端向上，上端分为冠突和髁突。咬肌覆盖它的外侧面，翼内肌覆盖它的内侧面；它构成颞下窝的外侧壁。

modelUnavailableReason.en: The bundled 3D model has no skull bones, so this landmark cannot be opened in 3D yet.
modelUnavailableReason.zh: 自带 3D 模型没有颅骨，这个骨性标志暂时不能在 3D 中打开。

description.en: The angle of the mandible is where the lower border of the body meets the posterior border of the ramus; in adults it measures roughly 110–130 degrees. The masseter attaches to its lateral side and the medial pterygoid to its medial side, and the stylomandibular ligament reaches its posterior margin. The point ST6 (Jiache) is located one fingerbreadth in front of and above it.
description.zh: 下颌角是下颌体下缘与下颌支后缘相交之处，成人约 110–130 度。咬肌附着于它的外侧，翼内肌附着于它的内侧，茎突下颌韧带到达它的后缘。颊车（ST6）在下颌角前上方一横指处。

modelUnavailableReason.zh: 自带 3D 模型没有颅骨，这个骨性标志暂时不能在 3D 中打开。

description.en: The mandibular foramen opens on the medial surface of the ramus, about midway between its anterior and posterior borders. The inferior alveolar nerve and vessels enter it to run in the mandibular canal. The lingula, a small tongue of bone in front of the foramen, gives attachment to the sphenomandibular ligament.
description.zh: 下颌孔开口于下颌支内侧面，大约在前后缘的中点。下牙槽神经和血管由此进入下颌管。下颌孔前方的小骨舌称下颌小舌，是蝶下颌韧带的附着处。

modelUnavailableReason.zh: 自带 3D 模型没有颅骨，这个骨性标志暂时不能在 3D 中打开。

description.en: The mental foramen opens on the outer surface of the body of the mandible, usually below the second premolar tooth (or between the two premolars), about halfway between the upper and lower borders. The mental nerve, the end of the inferior alveolar nerve, leaves through it to supply the skin of the chin and lower lip.
description.zh: 颏孔开口于下颌体外面，通常在第二前磨牙下方（或两颗前磨牙之间），大约位于上下缘的中间。颏神经（下牙槽神经的终支）由此穿出，分布于颏部和下唇的皮肤。

description.en: The mylohyoid line is the oblique ridge on the inner surface of the body of the mandible, running forward and downward from just below the third molar. Mylohyoid arises from it. The sublingual fossa lies above the line and the submandibular fossa below it.
description.zh: 下颌舌骨线是下颌体内面的斜行骨嵴，自第三磨牙下方向前下方延伸。下颌舌骨肌起自这条线。线的上方是舌下腺凹，下方是下颌下腺凹。

description.en: The digastric fossa is a small paired depression on the inner side of the lower border of the mandible, next to the midline. The anterior belly of the digastric arises from it.
description.zh: 二腹肌窝是下颌骨下缘内侧、正中线两旁的成对小凹陷。二腹肌前腹起自此处。

description.en: The mental spines (genial tubercles) are small paired projections on the back of the mandibular symphysis. Genioglossus arises from the superior pair and geniohyoid from the inferior pair.
description.zh: 颏棘是下颌联合后面成对的小突起。颏舌肌起自上颏棘，颏舌骨肌起自下颏棘。

description.en: The lateral pterygoid plate is the wider and shorter of the two plates of the pterygoid process of the sphenoid. Both pterygoid muscles arise from it: the inferior head of the lateral pterygoid from its lateral surface and the deep head of the medial pterygoid from its medial surface. It forms the front of the medial wall of the infratemporal fossa.
description.zh: 翼突外侧板是蝶骨翼突两块骨板中较宽较短的一块。两块翼肌都起自它：翼外肌下头起自外侧面，翼内肌深头起自内侧面。它构成颞下窝内侧壁的前部。

description.en: The foramen ovale is the opening in the greater wing of the sphenoid, in the roof of the infratemporal fossa, through which the mandibular nerve (CN V3) leaves the skull; the lesser petrosal nerve and an accessory meningeal artery also pass through it. The foramen spinosum, just behind it, carries the middle meningeal vessels.
description.zh: 卵圆孔位于蝶骨大翼、颞下窝的顶部，下颌神经（CN V3）由此出颅；岩小神经和脑膜副动脉也经过此孔。紧靠它后方的棘孔有脑膜中血管通过。

description.en: The temporal fossa is the shallow depression on the side of the skull above the zygomatic arch. The superior temporal line bounds it above and behind and gives attachment to the temporal fascia, which roofs it; the inferior temporal line marks the upper limit of temporalis. Its floor is formed by the frontal, parietal, sphenoid and temporal bones, which meet at the pterion.
description.zh: 颞窝是颅侧面颧弓上方的浅凹。上颞线是它的上界和后界，也是颞筋膜的附着处，颞筋膜盖在颞窝表面；下颞线是颞肌的上界。颞窝的底由额骨、顶骨、蝶骨和颞骨构成，四骨会合处称翼点。

description.en: The infratemporal fossa is the space below the temporal fossa and deep to the ramus of the mandible. Its roof is the greater wing of the sphenoid with the foramen ovale and foramen spinosum, its anterior wall the back of the maxilla, its medial wall the lateral pterygoid plate, and its lateral wall the ramus. It holds both pterygoid muscles, the maxillary artery, the pterygoid venous plexus and the branches of the mandibular nerve.
description.zh: 颞下窝是颞窝下方、下颌支深面的间隙。它的顶是带有卵圆孔和棘孔的蝶骨大翼，前壁是上颌骨后面，内侧壁是翼突外侧板，外侧壁是下颌支。窝内有两块翼肌、上颌动脉、翼静脉丛和下颌神经的分支。

question.en: Name the two compartments of the temporomandibular joint and say which movement happens in each when the mouth opens.
question.zh: 说出颞下颌关节的两个腔，以及张口时各发生什么运动。

answer.en: The articular disc divides the joint into a lower compartment, between the disc and the condyle, and an upper compartment, between the disc and the temporal bone. Opening starts with rotation of the condyle under the disc in the lower compartment, which gives roughly the first 20 mm. It continues with translation in the upper compartment: the condyle and disc glide forward together onto the articular tubercle. Normal full opening is about 40 to 50 mm between the incisors.
answer.zh: 关节盘把关节分成下腔（关节盘与髁突之间）和上腔（关节盘与颞骨之间）。张口先是髁突在下腔、关节盘下方转动，大约提供最初的 20 mm；接着是上腔的滑动：髁突和关节盘一起向前滑到关节结节下方。正常最大张口度在切牙间约 40～50 mm。

question.en: List the four muscles of mastication with their insertions, their nerve, and the one that opens the mouth.
question.zh: 列出四块咀嚼肌及其止点、神经，并指出哪一块张口。

answer.en: Masseter inserts onto the lateral surface of the ramus and angle of the mandible, temporalis onto the coronoid process, medial pterygoid onto the medial surface of the ramus and angle, and lateral pterygoid onto the pterygoid fovea on the neck of the mandible and the joint capsule and disc. All four are supplied by branches of the mandibular nerve (CN V3). Masseter, temporalis and medial pterygoid close the jaw; the lateral pterygoid is the only one that opens and protrudes it.
answer.zh: 咬肌止于下颌支和下颌角外侧面，颞肌止于冠突，翼内肌止于下颌支和下颌角内侧面，翼外肌止于下颌颈的翼肌凹以及关节囊和关节盘。四块肌都由下颌神经（CN V3）的分支支配。咬肌、颞肌和翼内肌闭口；只有翼外肌张口并前伸下颌。

question.en: The chin moves to the left. Which muscles produce the movement, and what does each condyle do?
question.zh: 颏部移向左侧。由哪些肌产生这个动作？两侧髁突各怎样运动？

answer.en: Moving the chin to the left is driven by the right lateral pterygoid and right medial pterygoid, which pull the right condyle forward and medially. The left condyle stays in its fossa and spins about a vertical axis, steadied by the left temporalis and masseter. A patient who cannot move the chin to the left therefore has a problem with translation of the right joint or with the right pterygoid muscles.
answer.zh: 颏部移向左侧由右侧翼外肌和右侧翼内肌带动，它们把右侧髁突拉向前内方。左侧髁突留在下颌窝内绕垂直轴旋转，由左侧颞肌和咬肌稳住。因此，颏部不能移向左侧的患者，问题在右侧关节的滑动或右侧翼肌。

question.en: Why do the two bellies of digastric have different nerves, and what are they?
question.zh: 二腹肌的前后两腹为什么神经不同？分别是什么神经？

answer.en: The anterior belly develops from the first pharyngeal arch and is supplied by the nerve to mylohyoid, a branch of the inferior alveolar nerve from the mandibular nerve (CN V3). The posterior belly develops from the second pharyngeal arch and is supplied by the digastric branch of the facial nerve (CN VII). The two bellies meet at an intermediate tendon that is held to the hyoid bone by a fibrous sling.
answer.zh: 前腹发育自第一咽弓，由下颌舌骨肌神经支配，它是下颌神经（CN V3）下牙槽神经的分支。后腹发育自第二咽弓，由面神经（CN VII）的二腹肌支支配。两腹在中间腱相连，中间腱由一个纤维环系在舌骨上。

question.en: Name the branches of the anterior and posterior divisions of the mandibular nerve and say which nerves supply the temporomandibular joint.
question.zh: 说出下颌神经前干和后干的分支，并指出哪些神经支配颞下颌关节。

answer.en: The anterior division gives the masseteric nerve, the deep temporal nerves, the nerve to lateral pterygoid and the sensory buccal nerve. The posterior division gives the auriculotemporal nerve, the lingual nerve and the inferior alveolar nerve, which gives the nerve to mylohyoid and ends as the mental nerve. The joint is supplied by the auriculotemporal nerve behind and laterally and by the masseteric nerve in front.
answer.zh: 前干发出咬肌神经、颞深神经、翼外肌神经和属于感觉神经的颊神经。后干发出耳颞神经、舌神经和下牙槽神经；下牙槽神经发出下颌舌骨肌神经，末端成为颏神经。关节的后部和外侧由耳颞神经支配，前部由咬肌神经支配。

question.en: Name the five terminal branches of the facial nerve from top to bottom and one test for each.
question.zh: 从上到下说出面神经的五条终末支，并各举一个检查动作。

answer.en: The five branches leave the front of the parotid gland: temporal, zygomatic, buccal, marginal mandibular and cervical. Raising the eyebrows tests the temporal branches, closing the eyes tightly the zygomatic branches, smiling or puffing out the cheeks the buccal branches, showing the lower teeth the marginal mandibular branch, and tensing the skin of the neck the cervical branch.
answer.zh: 五条分支自腮腺前缘发出：颞支、颧支、颊支、下颌缘支和颈支。抬眉检查颞支，用力闭眼检查颧支，微笑或鼓腮检查颊支，露出下牙检查下颌缘支，绷紧颈部皮肤检查颈支。

question.en: A patient cannot smile on the right side. How does the forehead tell a central from a peripheral facial palsy?
question.zh: 患者右侧不能微笑。怎样用前额区分中枢性和周围性面瘫？

answer.en: Ask the patient to raise both eyebrows and to close the eyes tightly. If the right forehead does not wrinkle and the right eye does not close, the whole half of the face is weak: this is a peripheral palsy of the right facial nerve, such as Bell palsy. If the forehead wrinkles on both sides and the eye closes, only the lower face is weak: this is a central palsy from a lesion in the left side of the brain, and a stroke must be excluded.
answer.zh: 让患者抬起双眉并用力闭眼。如果右侧前额不能皱起、右眼不能闭合，说明整个右半面都无力：这是右侧面神经的周围性面瘫，例如贝尔麻痹。如果两侧前额都能皱起、眼能闭合，只有面下部无力：这是左侧大脑病变引起的中枢性面瘫，必须排除脑卒中。

question.en: Compare disc displacement with reduction and without reduction: joint sound, opening range and path of the chin.
question.zh: 比较可复性和不可复性关节盘移位：关节杂音、张口度和颏部轨迹。

answer.en: In both, the disc lies in front of the condyle when the mouth is closed. With reduction, the condyle regains the disc during opening with a click; the opening range is normal and the chin swings toward the affected side and then returns to the midline. Without reduction, the disc stays in front and blocks translation: there is no click, opening is limited to about 30 mm or less when the lock is recent, and the chin deflects toward the affected side without returning.
answer.zh: 两者在闭口时关节盘都位于髁突前方。可复性：张口过程中髁突重新回到关节盘下方并发出弹响；张口度正常，颏部先偏向患侧再回到中线。不可复性：关节盘一直留在前方挡住滑动；没有弹响，闭锁初期张口度限于约 30 mm 以内，颏部偏向患侧且不回中线。

question.en: Give the standard location of ST7 (Xiaguan) and the structures under it.
question.zh: 写出下关（ST7）的标准定位及其下方的结构。

answer.en: ST7 is on the face, in the depression between the midpoint of the inferior border of the zygomatic arch and the mandibular notch, found with the mouth closed. Under the skin lie the parotid gland with branches of the facial nerve and the upper part of masseter. The masseteric nerve and vessels cross the mandibular notch, and deep to the notch the infratemporal fossa holds the lateral pterygoid, the maxillary artery, the pterygoid venous plexus and the branches of the mandibular nerve.
answer.zh: 下关在面部，颧弓下缘中央与下颌切迹之间的凹陷中，闭口取穴。皮下为腮腺（内有面神经分支）和咬肌上部。咬肌神经和血管跨过下颌切迹；切迹深面的颞下窝内有翼外肌、上颌动脉、翼静脉丛和下颌神经的分支。
