cranial.en: CN denotes a cranial nerve, numbered with a Roman numeral: CN V is the trigeminal nerve and CN VII is the facial nerve.
cranial.zh: CN 表示脑神经，用罗马数字编号：CN V 是三叉神经，CN VII 是面神经。

divisions.en: V1, V2 and V3 denote the three divisions of the trigeminal nerve: ophthalmic, maxillary and mandibular.
divisions.zh: V1、V2、V3 表示三叉神经的三个分支：眼神经、上颌神经和下颌神经。

cervical.en: C denotes cervical spinal nerves; C1 and C2–C3 appear in this chapter.
cervical.zh: C 表示颈部脊神经；本章出现 C1 和 C2–C3。

thoracic.en: T denotes thoracic levels; none is used in this chapter.
thoracic.zh: T 表示胸部节段；本章没有用到。

lumbar.en: L denotes lumbar levels; none is used in this chapter.
lumbar.zh: L 表示腰部节段；本章没有用到。

sacral.en: S denotes sacral levels; none is used in this chapter.
sacral.zh: S 表示骶部节段；本章没有用到。

spinalNerveVsVertebra.en: A spinal nerve level identifies a nerve, whereas a vertebral level identifies a bone. Specify which is being described.
spinalNerveVsVertebra.zh: 脊神经节段表示神经，椎骨节段表示骨骼；描述时应明确区分。

location.en: Stomach Meridian of Foot-Yangming. WHO 2008: On the face, in the depression between the midpoint of the inferior border of the zygomatic arch and the mandibular notch. Note: when the mouth is closed, ST7 is located at the depression inferior to the zygomatic arch, directly inferior to GB3.
location.zh: 足阳明胃经。在面部，颧弓下缘中央与下颌切迹之间凹陷中。注：闭口，上关（GB3）直下，颧弓下缘凹陷中。

layers.en: Skin and subcutaneous tissue with the parotid gland and branches of the facial nerve; the upper part of masseter; the mandibular notch, which the masseteric nerve and vessels cross on their way to the deep surface of masseter; and, deep to the notch in the infratemporal fossa, the lateral pterygoid, the maxillary artery, the pterygoid venous plexus and the branches of the mandibular nerve.
layers.zh: 皮肤和皮下组织，内有腮腺和面神经分支；咬肌上部；下颌切迹，咬肌神经和血管经此到咬肌深面；切迹深面的颞下窝内有翼外肌、上颌动脉、翼静脉丛和下颌神经的分支。

target.en: The point lies over the mandibular notch, the window between the coronoid and condylar processes. Masseter is the superficial muscle here and the lateral pterygoid lies deep to the notch. No source used here assigns a named trigger point to ST7 itself.
target.zh: 本穴位于下颌切迹表面，即冠突和髁突之间的缺口。浅层是咬肌，切迹深面是翼外肌。本章所用资料没有把某个具体触发点对应到下关本身。

howToFind.en: With the mouth closed, slide a finger forward from the tragus along the lower border of the zygomatic arch. About one finger-width in front of the condyle the finger drops into a hollow below the middle of the arch. Ask the person to open the mouth: the condyle glides forward and fills the hollow, which confirms the spot. GB3 lies directly above it on the upper border of the arch.
howToFind.zh: 闭口，手指自耳屏沿颧弓下缘向前滑。在髁突前方约一横指处，手指落入颧弓中点下方的凹陷。让对方张口：髁突向前滑动把凹陷填平，可以确认位置。上关（GB3）在它正上方的颧弓上缘。

safety.en: Deep to the mandibular notch lie the maxillary artery, the pterygoid venous plexus and the branches of the mandibular nerve; branches of the facial nerve cross the surface inside the parotid gland. This is a learning reference only and does not indicate needle depth, direction or path.
safety.zh: 下颌切迹深面有上颌动脉、翼静脉丛和下颌神经的分支；浅面的腮腺内有面神经分支经过。此处仅作学习参照，不表示进针深度、方向或路径。

location.en: Stomach Meridian of Foot-Yangming. WHO 2008: On the face, one fingerbreadth (middle finger) anterosuperior to the angle of the mandible. GB/T 12346-2021 adds a note: on the bisector of the angle of the mandible, where masseter bulges when the teeth are clenched and a depression is felt when it relaxes.
location.zh: 足阳明胃经。在面部，下颌角前上方一横指。注：沿下颌角角平分线上一横指，闭口咬紧牙时咬肌隆起，放松时按之有凹陷处。

layers.en: Skin and subcutaneous tissue; the fascia over masseter, with the lower end of the parotid gland behind it; the belly of masseter near its insertion on the angle and ramus; and the lateral surface of the ramus of the mandible.
layers.zh: 皮肤和皮下组织；咬肌表面的筋膜，后方为腮腺下端；咬肌肌腹，靠近它在下颌角和下颌支的止点；下颌支外侧面。

target.en: The belly of masseter. Masseter is one of the muscles palpated for familiar pain in the standard examination of temporomandibular disorders; no source used here maps a named trigger point to ST6 itself.
target.zh: 咬肌肌腹。在颞下颌关节紊乱的标准检查中，咬肌是需要触诊并询问“是否为熟悉的疼痛”的肌肉之一；本章所用资料没有把某个具体触发点对应到颊车本身。

howToFind.en: Find the angle of the mandible below the ear lobe. Place a finger one finger-width in front of and above it and ask the person to clench the teeth: masseter rises under the finger. When the jaw relaxes the finger sinks into a small hollow in the muscle.
howToFind.zh: 先在耳垂下方摸到下颌角。把手指放在它前上方一横指处，让对方咬紧牙：咬肌在指下隆起。放松时手指陷入肌肉上的小凹陷。

safety.en: The parotid gland with the branches of the facial nerve lies behind and above the point, and the facial artery crosses the lower border of the mandible at the front edge of masseter. This is a learning reference only and does not indicate needle depth, direction or path.
safety.zh: 腮腺和其中的面神经分支位于本穴后上方；面动脉在咬肌前缘处跨过下颌骨下缘。此处仅作学习参照，不表示进针深度、方向或路径。

location.en: Stomach Meridian of Foot-Yangming. WHO 2008: On the face, 0.4 F-cun lateral to the angle of the mouth. GB/T 12346-2021 adds a note: beside the angle of the mouth, on the nasolabial sulcus or its continuation.
location.zh: 足阳明胃经。在面部，口角旁开 0.4 寸。注：口角旁，在鼻唇沟或鼻唇沟延长线上。

layers.en: Skin and subcutaneous tissue; orbicularis oris at the angle of the mouth, where zygomaticus major and other muscles converge on it; and buccinator, which lines the cheek deep to them, with the mucosa of the mouth on its inner surface.
layers.zh: 皮肤和皮下组织；口角处的口轮匝肌，颧大肌等肌在此与它汇合；深面是衬在颊部的颊肌，颊肌内面为口腔黏膜。

target.en: The meeting point of the muscles that move the corner of the mouth: orbicularis oris, zygomaticus major and buccinator. These are the muscles that droop on the affected side in facial palsy.
target.zh: 牵动口角的几块肌的汇合处：口轮匝肌、颧大肌和颊肌。面瘫时患侧下垂的就是这些肌。

howToFind.en: Look straight at the face with the mouth closed and relaxed. The point is just lateral to the corner of the mouth, where the fold running down from the side of the nose (the nasolabial sulcus) or its continuation passes the corner.
howToFind.zh: 正面看，口唇自然闭合放松。本穴紧靠口角外侧，在自鼻旁向下的皱褶（鼻唇沟）或其延长线经过口角的地方。

safety.en: The facial artery and its branches to the lips pass close to the angle of the mouth, and the cheek is thin here: the oral cavity lies just deep to buccinator. This is a learning reference only and does not indicate needle depth, direction or path.
safety.zh: 面动脉及其到口唇的分支在口角附近经过；此处面颊很薄，颊肌深面就是口腔。此处仅作学习参照，不表示进针深度、方向或路径。

location.en: Small Intestine Meridian of Hand-Taiyang. WHO 2008: On the face, inferior to the zygomatic bone, in the depression directly inferior to the outer canthus of the eye.
location.zh: 手太阳小肠经。在面部，颧骨下缘，目外眦直下凹陷中。

layers.en: Skin and subcutaneous tissue; zygomaticus major close to its origin on the zygomatic bone; the anterior border of masseter, which arises from the zygomatic bone and arch; and buccinator deeper in the cheek.
layers.zh: 皮肤和皮下组织；颧大肌，靠近它在颧骨上的起点；咬肌前缘（咬肌起自颧骨和颧弓）；面颊更深处为颊肌。

target.en: The origin of zygomaticus major and the front edge of masseter below the zygomatic bone. No source used here assigns a named trigger point to SI18.
target.zh: 颧骨下方的颧大肌起点和咬肌前缘。本章所用资料没有把某个具体触发点对应到颧髎。

howToFind.en: Drop a vertical line from the outer corner of the eye. Follow it down over the cheekbone until the finger slips off the lower edge of the zygomatic bone into a hollow. Clenching the teeth makes the front edge of masseter stand out just behind the point.
howToFind.zh: 从目外眦向下作一条垂线。手指沿此线越过颧骨向下，直到滑下颧骨下缘、落入凹陷。咬紧牙时，咬肌前缘就在本穴后方隆起。

safety.en: Branches of the facial nerve cross the cheek at this level on their way to the muscles around the mouth and eye; the infraorbital foramen (the site of ST2) lies medial to and above the point. This is a learning reference only and does not indicate needle depth, direction or path.
safety.zh: 面神经分支在这一平面跨过面颊，去往口周和眼周的肌；眶下孔（四白 ST2 所在处）位于本穴内上方。此处仅作学习参照，不表示进针深度、方向或路径。

location.en: Small Intestine Meridian of Hand-Taiyang. WHO 2008: On the face, in the depression between the anterior border of the centre of the tragus and the posterior border of the condylar process of the mandible. GB/T 12346-2021 adds a note: with the mouth slightly open, in the depression in front of the middle of the tragus, between TE21 and GB2.
location.zh: 手太阳小肠经。在面部，耳屏正中与下颌骨髁突之间的凹陷中。注：微张口，耳屏正中前缘凹陷中，在耳门（TE21）与听会（GB2）之间。

layers.en: Skin and subcutaneous tissue; the upper part of the parotid gland; the superficial temporal artery and vein with the auriculotemporal nerve, which climb in front of the ear; and the back of the capsule of the temporomandibular joint with the retrodiscal tissue behind the condyle.
layers.zh: 皮肤和皮下组织；腮腺上部；在耳前上行的颞浅动、静脉和耳颞神经；颞下颌关节囊后部，以及髁突后方的盘后组织。

target.en: The posterior side of the temporomandibular joint. Pressing just in front of the tragus while the mouth opens and closes is the standard way to palpate the joint; no muscle belly lies under this point.
target.zh: 颞下颌关节的后方。在耳屏前方按压并让对方开闭口，是触诊这个关节的常规方法；本穴下方没有肌腹。

howToFind.en: Place a fingertip just in front of the middle of the tragus and ask the person to open the mouth slightly. The condyle slides forward and a hollow opens under the finger. TE21 is directly above it, in front of the notch above the tragus, and GB2 directly below, in front of the notch below the tragus.
howToFind.zh: 把指尖放在耳屏正中的前方，让对方微微张口。髁突向前滑动，指下出现凹陷。耳门（TE21）在它正上方、耳屏上切迹前；听会（GB2）在它正下方、耳屏间切迹前。

safety.en: The superficial temporal vessels and the auriculotemporal nerve run through this hollow, and the facial nerve crosses the parotid gland just below and in front of it. This is a learning reference only and does not indicate needle depth, direction or path.
safety.zh: 颞浅血管和耳颞神经从这个凹陷经过，面神经在其前下方穿过腮腺。此处仅作学习参照，不表示进针深度、方向或路径。

location.en: Triple Energizer Meridian of Hand-Shaoyang. Translation of GB/T 12346-2021: On the face, in the depression between the supratragic notch and the condylar process of the mandible. Note: with the mouth slightly open, in the depression in front of the supratragic notch, directly above SI19.
location.zh: 手少阳三焦经。在面部，耳屏上切迹与下颌骨髁突之间的凹陷中。注：微张口，耳屏上切迹前的凹陷中，听宫（SI19）直上。

layers.en: Skin and subcutaneous tissue; the superficial temporal artery and vein and the auriculotemporal nerve; the upper edge of the parotid gland; and the upper back part of the capsule of the temporomandibular joint, at the root of the zygomatic arch.
layers.zh: 皮肤和皮下组织；颞浅动、静脉和耳颞神经；腮腺上缘；颞下颌关节囊的后上部，位于颧弓根部。

target.en: The upper posterior side of the temporomandibular joint. No muscle belly lies under this point.
target.zh: 颞下颌关节的后上方。本穴下方没有肌腹。

howToFind.en: Find SI19 in front of the middle of the tragus, then move the fingertip up to the small notch between the top of the tragus and the rim of the ear. With the mouth slightly open the point is the hollow just in front of that notch.
howToFind.zh: 先在耳屏正中前方找到听宫，再把指尖上移到耳屏上端与耳轮之间的小切迹。微张口时，这个切迹前方的凹陷就是本穴。

safety.en: The superficial temporal artery and vein and the auriculotemporal nerve run through this hollow. This is a learning reference only and does not indicate needle depth, direction or path.
safety.zh: 颞浅动、静脉和耳颞神经从这个凹陷经过。此处仅作学习参照，不表示进针深度、方向或路径。

location.en: Gallbladder Meridian of Foot-Shaoyang. Translation of GB/T 12346-2021: On the face, in the depression between the intertragic notch and the condylar process of the mandible. Note: with the mouth slightly open, in the depression in front of the intertragic notch, directly below SI19.
location.zh: 足少阳胆经。在面部，耳屏间切迹与下颌骨髁突之间的凹陷中。注：微张口，耳屏间切迹前方的凹陷中。听宫（SI19）直下。

layers.en: Skin and subcutaneous tissue; the parotid gland, which fills the space between the ear and the back edge of the ramus; within the gland, from superficial to deep, the branches of the facial nerve, the retromandibular vein and the external carotid artery; and the back of the neck of the mandible.
layers.zh: 皮肤和皮下组织；腮腺，填在耳与下颌支后缘之间；腺体内由浅入深依次为面神经分支、下颌后静脉和颈外动脉；下颌颈的后面。

target.en: The lower posterior side of the temporomandibular joint and the neck of the mandible. No muscle belly lies under this point.
target.zh: 颞下颌关节的后下方和下颌颈。本穴下方没有肌腹。

howToFind.en: Find SI19 in front of the middle of the tragus, then move the fingertip down to the notch at the lower end of the tragus (the intertragic notch). With the mouth slightly open the point is the hollow just in front of that notch.
howToFind.zh: 先在耳屏正中前方找到听宫，再把指尖下移到耳屏下端的切迹（耳屏间切迹）。微张口时，这个切迹前方的凹陷就是本穴。

safety.en: The facial nerve divides inside the parotid gland at this level, with the retromandibular vein and the external carotid artery deep to it. This is a learning reference only and does not indicate needle depth, direction or path.
safety.zh: 面神经在这一平面的腮腺内分支，其深面为下颌后静脉和颈外动脉。此处仅作学习参照，不表示进针深度、方向或路径。

location.en: Triple Energizer Meridian of Hand-Shaoyang. Translation of GB/T 12346-2021: In the neck region, posterior to the ear lobe, in the depression anterior to the inferior end of the mastoid process.
location.zh: 手少阳三焦经。在颈部，耳垂后方，乳突下端前方凹陷中。

layers.en: Skin and subcutaneous tissue, supplied here by cervical nerves (C2–C3) and not by the trigeminal nerve; the back of the parotid gland; the gap between the mastoid process behind and the ramus of the mandible in front; and, deep in the gap, the styloid process with the facial nerve leaving the stylomastoid foramen just behind it. The posterior belly of digastric arises from the medial side of the mastoid process nearby.
layers.zh: 皮肤和皮下组织，这里的皮肤由颈神经（C2–C3）而不是三叉神经支配；腮腺后部；后方乳突与前方下颌支之间的间隙；间隙深处为茎突，面神经就在茎突后方的茎乳孔出颅。二腹肌后腹起自附近的乳突内侧。

target.en: The place where the facial nerve leaves the skull and enters the parotid gland. No muscle belly is the target here.
target.zh: 面神经出颅并进入腮腺的地方。这里没有作为目标的肌腹。

howToFind.en: Fold the ear lobe back against the neck. Behind it, feel the rounded tip of the mastoid process and the back edge of the ramus of the mandible in front. The point is the hollow between them, level with the lower end of the mastoid process; it deepens when the mouth opens.
howToFind.zh: 把耳垂向后贴在颈部。在耳垂后方摸到圆钝的乳突尖，前方摸到下颌支后缘。两者之间、平乳突下端的凹陷就是本穴；张口时凹陷加深。

safety.en: The trunk of the facial nerve lies deep in this hollow as it leaves the stylomastoid foramen; the external carotid artery and the retromandibular vein run in the parotid gland in front of it. This is a learning reference only and does not indicate needle depth, direction or path.
safety.zh: 面神经主干出茎乳孔后就在这个凹陷的深处；颈外动脉和下颌后静脉走在其前方的腮腺内。此处仅作学习参照，不表示进针深度、方向或路径。
